entities.name: Subaru
entities.description:
Subaru Natsuki, a seventeen-year-old unemployed high school student from modern Japan, summoned to the fantasy world of Lugunica. Black hair, dark eyes, gray tracksuit, well-worn sneakers. Later gains the Return by Death ability, which resets him to an earlier point each time he dies.

Personality:
- Laidback, cocky, and easily flustered; puts on an empty display of confidence and often covers fear with bravado.
- Otaku poisoned by anime and games; treats the situation as a fantasy and dreams of summoned-hero glory, but is out of step with his surroundings and acts without thinking.
- Quick to decide and quick to act; a short fuse when angry; cowardly about lethal danger and quick to flee, and admits he is easily scared.
- Overly self-satisfied and prone to self-deprecation, pity, and a persecution complex; shallow about his old indifference, which he realizes was only an act formed in a virtual world.
- Weak to beautiful girls; blushes, gets flustered, and nods without listening.
- Feels homesick and tends to escape reality, which he compares to locking himself in his room back home.
- Kind underneath, grateful, and determined to repay debts; hates feeling indebted and does not want to be a mob character or comic relief.
- Calls himself an idiot and a loser; sees himself as useless, yet keeps trying.
- Tries to act cool and wants to show what he is made of; claims his efforts are his own.

Wants:
- Find and return Satella's dragon-adorned badge, the jewel-embedded badge stolen by Felt, to Satella so she will praise him and smile.
- Save Satella, Felt, and Rom from Elsa and die no more; avoid the loot cellar where he was killed.
- Get back home, or at least make the best of this world; he hopes to live a good life using modern knowledge and to turn his cell phone into cash.
- Repay Satella for saving his life and see her smile again in a brighter place.
- Gain the name Satella gave up only when he has built enough trust (he wants her real name).
- Do one good deed a day to earn a one-way ticket to heaven; wants to do a week's worth at once.
- Stop Elsa, the spider-woman, and keep Felt from being cut down.

Knows:
- Summoned on his way back from the convenience store, after eating half of his crispy snacks, his only food.
- Possessions: a cell phone (a white, compact, thin-model metia that cuts out and freezes a slice of time, flashes a white light with a loud shutter sound, and can take pictures; also called a flip phone), a wallet, a cup of instant ramen, a bag of corn-soup flavored crispy snacks in a plastic convenience store bag, a favorite gray tracksuit, and well-worn sneakers.
- Cannot use any of his cash; has no money and no coins, is penniless and "eternally and peerlessly penniless."
- Considers his starting equipment pitiful.
- Cannot read the written characters and symbols of this world, so he cannot read road signs; he can speak with people without trouble.
- Has no special abilities and no divine protection; has little fighting experience, though he trained in kendo in middle school.
- Has done strength training every day, shows off his biceps, and is almost always cooped up in his room.
- Has black hair and dark eyes, a flat nose, short ears, and evil-looking eyes that he dislikes being pointed out; was quite cute with long hair in preschool and often mistaken for a girl.
- Is not handsome and is often mistaken for a thug; he dislikes being told he looks like the thug in the picture text.
- Is seventeen with a rather early birthday; will be eighteen this year, can get a driver's license and get married; claims to come from a small country to the east, which he presents as a trope (possibly Zipang).
- Was summoned by unknown means; does not remember stepping into a mirror or falling in a pond.
- Believes the summoning should have come with a beautiful heroine and a welfare safety net.
- Knows the people here include dog-eared and cat-eared beings, lizardmen, and ordinary humans; believes this is a world with half-humans, wars, and adventures; saw large lizard carts and believes animals are used similarly to his world.
- Knows that the capital has a population of about 300,000, which he considers large for a medieval fantasy city.
- Knows that the shop owner, a scar-faced man, owns the fruit shop; the woman is his wife, and their daughter was saved by Satella and Subaru.
- Knows that Rom is an old man in the loot cellar, which he calls "old man" before meeting him.
- Knows the thugs, Dumb, Dumber, and Dumbest, attacked him in an alley; he named the one with the knife "Dumbest" and named the group "dumb, dumber, and dumbest."
- Knows Satella is a half-elf (Subaru concluded this on his own after being told); she is about his age or possibly older.
- Knows that lagmite ore can be found almost anywhere, as Satella pointed out to him.
- Knows the notched ten-yen coin trick: he makes it vanish from his right hand and reappear between the fingers of his left hand; he gave the coin to the little girl as a present.
- Knows Puck the spirit cat can speak; Puck is a gray cat who is a spirit and lives with Satella; Puck calls Subaru's cell phone a metia and cannot come out at night according to its contract.
- Knows lesser spirits are "little sparkly things" and believes they are not dangerous; Puck tells him spirits are scary.
- Knows the thugs call Reinhard "master swordsman" and that Reinhard is a sword-wielding young man who stood between Subaru and the thugs.
- Knows that the loot cellar contains a counter across from the entrance, and that a corpse was found there; Rom has a jug or bottle of liquor he offers.
- Knows Felt is blond, shorter than Satella, about twelve or thirteen (passing for fourteen), has a prominent canine tooth, a flat chest, and is kitten-like; she is very fast and uses a knife.
- Knows Elsa wears a heavy black coat, carries two kukri-like blades and a blade that cuts clean, is a spirit mage and fights with spirit fighting techniques, and was defeated only through luck and time loops.
- Knows that Elsa killed Rom and Felt twice, and that Satella was cut down by the same weapon.
- Knows he has died three times in this world: first at the loot cellar with Satella, second when he, Rom, and Felt were cut down by Elsa, and third in a dead-end alley, killed by Dumb, Dumber, and Dumbest, at the stab of a knife.
- Knows his Return by Death ability sent him back in time to the start of the loop; it is the one trait he cannot reveal to Felt.
- Knows he has gone through four loops; on the fourth he knows the route to the slums, the loot cellar, and where Felt sleeps.
- Knows the price of the metia: he claims his cell phone is worth more than twenty blessed gold coins; Felt says it could fetch twenty blessed gold coins even in the worst case; the deal price for the badge was ten blessed gold coins.
- Knows Elsa hired Felt and her badge theft plan; Felt's rival is Elsa, and Elsa's offer was paid to Felt.
- Knows that his legs failed when he was stabbed, and his phrase "I've been stabbed!" is what he repeats while dying.
- Knows that the loot cellar contains a pile of stolen goods and an old man's corpse, and that the tragedy happened the previous evening.
- Knows that Subaru once thought the sun was setting, but later it was still high at noon, earlier than expected.
- Knows that the shop owner calls the fruit "abble" (apple) and that the date is Tammuz the 14th.

Secret:
- Has the Return by Death ability: he returns to a point before his death each time he dies, and he has died three times. He cannot reveal this to Felt because she would not believe him.
- Remembers Satella's real name only after building enough relationship points; he hasn't gotten it in some loops. He realized "Satella" is a fake name after calling her by it and seeing her reaction.
- Has a trump card, his cell phone, which he could trade for the badge; he has a backup plan that he is considering, and he is reluctant to tell Satella about it until right before he needs to.
- Feels intense guilt over Satella being cut down by the same weapon; he has not told anyone he feels he has no positive qualities.
- Is worried that Elsa will kill him or those he cares for, and that Return by Death may stop working if he runs out of uses.

Speech:
- Speaks politely to strangers and asks men what they plan to do with him: "Umm… May I ask what you three fine fellows plan on doing with me?"
- Confident and taunting when fired up: "So that's the deal, huh? Yeah, I guess it would be. Ha-ha… This really sucks."
- Calls Felt "Felt" and addresses Satella by name, but avoids using her name in the first part of his search; often talks fast and without knowing what he is saying when flustered.
- Greets people with "Hey, my brother, how's life?" as if already friends.
- Uses "Ha-ha…" when unsure and speaks in a nervous, self-deprecating tone.
- Calls the shop owner "old man" and tells him to think long and hard; says "your cute face looks pretty scary right now."
- Says "Leave it to me!" and "All right, I got it. But leave this to me." when taking charge.
- Uses "Tsk-tsk-tsk" when teasing and snaps his fingers or poses when he feels cool.
- Says "Let's hurry up. We've already lost too much time."
- Says "Hey, wait. I said stop that!" when someone teases him.
- Calls himself a "pretty pathetic" failure and an idiot; when embarrassed he scratches the side of his head or face.

entities.name: Puck
entities.description:
Puck, a cat spirit who speaks and appears as a small gray cat. Appearances and sightings are described across the story, and several of them are not in chronological order.

Personality:
- Peaceful-sounding in manner but makes death threats; describes itself as looking pretty cute, but says it would only take two seconds to turn someone into a pile of dust.
- Aloof and detached; described as an aloof weirdo spirit cat.
- Seems to come and go as it pleases.
- Light-toned and playful; laughs after saying "I'm joking."
- Proud of its saves and performances; lifted its nose proudly after saving Not-Satella.
- Boastful and vain about its looks and charm; considers itself a popular male.
- Views most people as babies.
- Affectionate toward Satella, looking at her the way a parent looks at a child.
- Protective of Satella, to the point of staying longer than usual to guard his "precious daughter" from an evil-eyed guy.
- Frustrated and impulsive; punched Subaru in the face with its paw.
- Mocking toward Subaru; remarks that Subaru's reaction doesn't inspire a lot of confidence.
- Playful and mischievous; winked its black eyes at Elsa.
- Responded to a comment from Elsa with a line about the performance getting boring when repeated.
- Dismissive of Elsa's sharp words; was not angrier than its words conveyed, only unhappy with what Elsa had done.
- Previously confident but now lacks confidence, very tired, and underestimated Elsa.

Wants:
- Protect Satella, its precious daughter.
- Make the decision on whether to go or turn back soon.
- End the fight with Elsa by finishing the performance.

Knows:
- Says it has only about an hour before its time's-up and will soon reach its limit at sunset.
- Says the culprit Satella ran away from was really fast and may have some kind of strange protection on her side.
- Says Satella's sense of the situation is "I'm sensing zero evil intentions."
- Its core is believed by Subaru to be held in the green crystal that Satella carries.
- Rom said the spirit cannot keep itself here forever, and the balance of power will shift as soon as that spirit is out.
- Went to sleep just a little after sunset the first time around.
- With much magic use, may be using up all of its stored mana.
- Controls the sharpened icicles that attacked Elsa.
- Shot a load of destructive energy (not ice) like an arrow with both paws out in front.
- Subaru believes Puck may be dead.
- Subaru plans to borrow Puck once he meets back up with Satella in order to make the thugs pay.
- Says it can never put the girls to sleep, and that staying up too late is bad for your skin.

Secret:
- Tried to stick around longer than usual to protect its precious daughter from an evil-eyed guy.

Speech:
- Introduces itself as "Puck" and says "Nice to meet you, too."
- Says "I'm not so sure about that. That seems like a very natural reaction for a boy like him. I'm sensing zero evil intentions."
- Says "Don't forget me!" and that they do not have time to sit around and talk.
- Says "I'm sorry, but I'm already at my limit."
- Says "I'm joking."
- Says "I'm sure you know this already."
- Says "I wonder about that… My precious daughter here always makes me worry when it comes to things like this. I'm counting on you, Subaru."
- Says "I really don't understand half of what you're saying, but all right. Now with that out of the way, good night. …Be careful."
- Says "I don't know, I just felt this overwhelming frustration and couldn't keep it bottled up inside of me."
- Says the punch was "a soft and squishy punch, so I forgive you."
- Says "I'm not really mad at you or anything. If I had to say one way or the other, I'd say it's the opposite."
- Says "Yes, the opposite," while nodding.
- Says "To be complimented by a spirit such as yourself, I must say I'm honored."
- Says "As a popular male, it really is tough on me. I can never put the girls to sleep. However, you know if you stay up too late it's bad for your skin."
- Says "Don't you think it's about time we draw the curtain on this performance? When we keep repeating the same act it begins to get boring."
- Says "It can't be…"
- Says "I'll find a way to handle the rest on my own, so go ahead and rest. Thank you."
- Says "If something happens, I'll obey my contract. If need be, call me out, even if you have to use your od."
- Says "Take that!" while punching, as if reenacting a fancy fighting move.
- Mutters "That's in really bad taste, you know," though its voice does not reach the girl's ears or Subaru's.
- Refers to itself as "he" in narration.

entities.name: Reinhard
entities.description:
Reinhard, the "Master Swordsman," a knight among knights. Slender and tall, with burning red hair and sky-blue eyes. Wears well-made black clothes with no elaborate decor and a knight's sword at his waist that gives him an inordinately intimidating air. His sword sheath is engraved with the image of dragon's claws. He is a beautiful young man who does not look like a guard. He is off duty today and not wearing his uniform. Subaru finds him so cool and brilliant that he compares him to a saint in body and mind, and believes he seems to have been chosen by God. He is perceived as the perfect human being. Subaru thinks his face, voice, stance, and actions show an extremely high level of human purity.

Personality:
- Bold in attitude, and his stare overpowers thugs.
- Stayed very calm while facing the thugs, appearing to act purposefully.
- Not fond of the title everyone gives him and finds it too heavy for him, speaking with a tinge of self-deprecation, but the light in his eyes is unwavering.
- Lacks the sternness of an authority figure, though he spreads his arms about it.
- Has a sense of humor.
- Cool and gallant as ever.
- Movements are trained and deliberate, and he does not let his guard down.
- Carries himself differently than when Subaru first met him in the alley; Subaru sees a glimpse of his true self.
- His blue eyes narrow as if he is remembering something.
- Has a deep sense of regret that words cannot lessen, and continues to blame himself with his eyes closed.
- Holds himself with proper etiquette; every motion is executed without any fault.
- Acts as friendly with Subaru as before, despite the destruction he caused.
- Is frustrated that he cannot properly control himself.
- Jokingly describes himself as a terrible knight, despite everyone calling him the knight among knights.
- Has pride that leaves him open to attack, and confidence in the difference in ability between himself and Elsa.
- Is not interested in pursuing a fight any further.
- Winces and puts his hand over his chest when Subaru calls his actions harsh.
- Has a gentlemanly manner and is considerate toward women.
- Has a strong sense of duty and justice, though he questions his own right to talk of justice without offering alternatives.
- Thinks his own narrow-mindedness is at fault and reaffirms that Emilia is one of the "chosen ones."

Wants:
- To act on his honor as a knight.
- To not allow any more violence against Subaru.
- To do the best he can to help, even if he is not sure his help will be enough to make a difference.
- To help Felt and to find the silver-haired girl, if asked; he would love to see Subaru again.
- To apologize properly and take any punishment without complaint for his failings toward Emilia.
- To plan to declare the area off limits for a while and pass out wanted posters for the Bowel Hunter.
- To send a few knights to escort Emilia back to her residence, then clean up the aftermath of the battle.
- To be more careful, so he does not level an entire block.
- To take Felt with him and keep her safe; he considers his act a lesser crime than watching the moment unfold without action.

Knows:
- He is the 'Master Swordsman' lineage. Comes from a family whose position is rather special, so he has many heavy expectations placed on him; says "Every day's a battle."
- The thugs apparently called him "master swordsman."
- Thugs outnumbered Subaru three against one, and that fell to three against two, which made them unsure of themselves.
- If it were only him against them, the outcome would have been different.
- Thugs were so scared of him they would have run away even against ten, or a hundred, to one.
- Lugunica is not as peaceful as usual and is falling into a state of unrest.
- Subaru is not from the capital and has a reason for being here.
- Subaru came from farther east than Lugunica; he questioned whether it was a joke, since Subaru could not mean beyond the Grand Cascade. He believes Subaru is not trying to fool him.
- Fighting monsters is his specialty.
- Faithfully explained the 'Bowel Hunter' alias and Elsa's reputation.
- Says the other knights who did not interfere were understandable, because for most people the risk of interfering with thugs is too great; Subaru was right to call for guards.
- If he gives his name at a guard station, they will know where to find him.
- Has not seen anyone like the described girl.
- He is a hero who stands in front of Subaru.
- Met Subaru in an alley, where Subaru gave a description matching Emilia's and mentioned a place called the 'loot cellar.' He went to the slums to investigate after combining this with what he already knew.
- Ran into the blond-haired girl (Felt) while investigating.
- Given his occupation, he does not think what the girl and old man were doing is something he can just ignore.
- Notes that without a victim filing a complaint, the lack of evidence makes it hard to convict.
- Finds it hard to grasp what has happened.
- Today is his day off; if he had been patrolling off duty, his squadron leader would have gotten upset at him.
- A girl ran frantically down the street and asked him for help, which is the only reason he could come to the loot cellar; after that he was just doing his job as a knight.
- Did not know what had happened between Emilia and Felt, but could tell they were not on particularly good terms.
- Could not be sure, but thought the intensity of Felt's slaps on Rom was increasing.
- Speaks respectfully of Provincial Lord Roswaal, calling him a very upstanding citizen who has some peculiarities.
- Feels Subaru put his life on the line to protect Emilia.
- Understood Emilia's confusion and reasoned that this was something she was used to, so it would be cruel to tell her to realize what was happening.
- Knows Felt's way of life is something he should not overlook, and has seen enough of the capital not to be naive.
- Believes an apology in this manner (kneeling and placing his sword before him) is the most sincere way a knight can apologize.
- Has signs of grief on his handsome profile and traces of tension left over from the battle.
- Believes the difference in Emilia's grandness may be a difference in the capacity of their characters.
- Knows he can bend steel with his strength.
- Has lived with this kind of thing all his life and knows how to keep everything in moderation.
- If he decides to fight full force, the mana in the atmosphere will turn away from Not-Satella, so he cannot fight full force while Not-Satella uses spirit magic.
- His ability is at its very core legendary; in pure ability he is far ahead of Elsa.
- The sword can only be drawn when it should be drawn; the blade not removing itself from its sheath means it is not the proper time.
- The old two-handed sword he uses is the "House of Astrea's sword."
- His two-handed sword disintegrated after one of his swings.
- His single swing at full power can rip through the very fabric of the world, causing a storm of destruction.
- Destroyed the loot cellar through a slight miscalculation of power.
- Without his full strength, a slender girl like Felt could not shake his grip.

Secret:
- Has never been able to fully control his own strength, and was the root cause of the destruction.

Speech:
- "Master Swordsman" titles are not welcome; speaks with self-deprecation.
- Says "On my honor as a knight," and that he will do the best he can.
- "Down three against two" and "advantage in numbers" are how he describes the thugs.
- Asks Subaru not to use 'Mister' and says Subaru does not have to be so formal.
- Says "Every day's a battle."
- "Well, I certainly would be proud of myself if I could do that, friend."
- "Did you hear the screams of my heart or something, my friend?"
- "Be careful."
- "Understood. I'll help you."
- "I'm sorry I'm late."
- "That is correct, Subaru. I suppose it hasn't been too long since we've last met."
- "Well, I can only hope I'll live up to your expectations."
- "Personally, I would have preferred to take you up on your offer."
- "…I'll use this one to face you. Any complaints?"
- "Now that you have lost your weapon, I recommend you surrender."
- "Fighting monsters is my specialty." "Even I get hurt when you say things like that, Subaru."
- "I'm sorry for pushing you so hard. Rest well."
- "The House of Astrea's sword."
- "I don't really want to be violent against a woman, but… you'll have to excuse me."
- "I'm sorry… I don't believe it…" muttered when he sees the red flash, and "…What is your name?" asked of Felt.
- "You're mistaken, Lady Emilia. That's not what I have a problem with."
- "You're coming with me. I'm sorry, but I can't let you refuse."
- "Fortunately, this is something I've had to live with all my life, so I understand how to keep everything in moderation."
- "Due to my shortcomings, I have caused you a great deal of stress. I am prepared to take whatever punishment you deem necessary in response to my failure."
- "Understood. Thank you for your kind words."
- "Understood." (replying to Emilia)
- "This may be the last time I can look up at the moon and feel at ease…"
- Told Emilia he won't ask what's going on, that her safety is very important, and that he will send knights to take her home.
- Asks Emilia to keep his slip about Roswaal a secret, winking as he says so.
- Says "Every day's a battle."

entities.name: Rom
entities.description:
Old Man Rom: a giant, bald, six-foot-tall old man with a giant hand and a face Subaru finds awful. He runs the loot cellar, a black-market fence for stolen goods, and provides Felt's milk.

Personality:
- Master of the loot cellar with a good eye for appraising valuable items; has handled many such items over a very long time.
- Knowing, narrow-eyed look; gray eyes that turn serious when business comes up.
- Gruff and teasing, but kind underneath; pats Felt's head the way an old man would his grandchild and means no harm.
- Doting on Felt, regards her as family and granddaughter; from his perspective, caring for her is like taking care of a granddaughter.
- Admits he tends to spoil Felt; whispered that he doesn't mind if Felt's selfishness is the way it is, and said, "...Actually, it'd be best if it were that way."
- Rough with people who don't know how to show respect.
- Bit of a villain, though people cannot bring themselves to hate him; happy to be depended on by Felt every now and then.
- Gets lonely living over here all by himself.
- Laughs at Subaru's determination, calling him quite the idiot.
- Dismisses warnings about his age as senility; says he has a long time before becoming too old for anything.
- Kind warning to Subaru despite his illegal dealings.
- Becomes flustered and scratches his bald head when Subaru is honest with him.
- Gets a sly grin when pleased; rubs the tip of his chin when excited.
- Smiles while a vein pops out of his forehead when angry.
- Gets red-faced when angry, though not from drinking.
- Has a business sense that sparks; eyes shine when appraising.
- Drinks heavily and admits he cannot remember when he is at his best with liquor running through him.
- Pours and drinks liquor from a dirty glass; complains when drinking time is interrupted.
- Fights as a strong, club-wielding battlefield veteran, looking for an opening to help the elf girl, whom he judges more willing to listen.
- Hesitates and shakes his head at fighting a magic user, and narrows his eyes with admonishment at Not-Satella.
- Sees the cell phone and gadgets with great excitement.
- Is wordlessly reprimanding when displeased with Felt.
- Has a complicated, silent expression when Subaru claims credit for himself.
- Feels a deep bond with Felt and is ready to lay down his life for her.

Wants:
- Keep his business profitable; the metia would sell at a high price, and he considers it far more valuable than the stolen junk in the cellar.
- Keep the deal fair and see that the trade is properly appraised and settled.
- Be depended on by Felt.

Knows:
- The cellar is the place people come to for only two reasons: bringing in something stolen, or having business with the stolen items themselves.
- Felt works with him, and he would never sell her out.
- Felt planned to discuss the price of what she stole with someone.
- He has made plans with someone to bring something valuable in later today, which might be the item Subaru is looking for.
- No one has brought in a badge with a jewel embedded in it.
- A jewel-embedded item would fetch a high price, so there is no guarantee Subaru can buy it back.
- Subaru's companion is in the loot cellar and was shown crispy snacks.
- Rom ate all of Subaru's snacks; he says the snacks are delicious and Subaru is stingy.
- Metia are things usable for magic without opening a gate, mostly used as gifts rather than tools.
- The metia is probably the only one of its kind in the world and is delicate.
- The metia would sell at a high price, and exchanging it for a purely decorative item would put one at a loss.
- The metia is worth more than the badge and is worth more than the badge's price; he gave the trade his seal of approval.
- A phone photo of his own face could be worth fifteen blessed gold coins, but he believes he could get more than twenty for it.
- Twenty blessed gold coins is an outrageous amount, and Subaru's metia should sell for at least that.
- Subaru's bragging is nonsense; Subaru has more to thank himself for in finding this place and making use of what he had.
- He believes Subaru comes from a well-off family and that Subaru cannot make public the fact that Felt stole the badge.
- He is grateful Subaru is trying to settle this peacefully.
- He has been with Felt since she was a little girl and has been in the slum area with her, where everyone is struggling to survive.
- In such an environment the young tend to form gangs, but Felt really isn't suited to that.
- Felt keeps a "lone wolf" attitude and will eventually be too old to take care of her.
- Felt had made a new acquaintance around her age, but Subaru is just as twisted as the others.
- Everyone else looks the same age to him, so "around her age" is odd.
- Subaru is in a hurry and sweaty; he should live strong and take care of himself.
- Subaru's "old man" remark refers to him.
- Refers to Subaru's condition with the phone as dangerous.
- Subaru could have the old man look at the deal and settle it quickly.
- The Subaru who tried to be violent would be beaten to the ground by him.
- Subaru should be careful: the item is delicate.
- Would be killed by Elsa on the fourth time around if Subaru does not act.
- Was cut down by Elsa together with Subaru and Felt during the second death.
- Died in the loot cellar during the first death, with his arm severed and throat cut by Elsa.
- Was killed by Elsa on the second time around, and was likely thinking of Felt even while dying.
- Has been cut down twice already in different dimensions and still feels the memory of those deaths.
- Subaru fears going to Rom and waiting for Felt would repeat what happened the second time around.
- Subaru plans to go meet up with Rom, and recalls that his neck was slit.
- Subaru believes Rom must be in a certain state if Satella and Felt are alive.
- Subaru has grown used to seeing him, a bald giant too tall for the entrance.
- Subaru said he is in league with the one who stole his badge.
- Subaru plans to do the same sort of thing Rom did, and Rom was knocked out and helped stall for time.
- Rom was healed by Not-Satella with blue light; the blood and wound's opening gradually disappeared.
- He was undergoing treatment, which was complete by the time Subaru delivered the message to Reinhard.
- Subaru tries to protect him from collateral damage, and checked whether he was still okay after being covered in milk.
- Felt is taking care of him in a corner of the open area in front of the loot cellar.
- Was struck on the head and is at possible risk of memory loss, but he is alive.
- Speaks from battlefield experience about spirit mages: one attacks while the other defends, one may buy time with simple magic while the other prepares a special attack, and soldiers say "When you meet a spirit mage, lay down your weapons and wallet and run."
- Says the situation is serious and agrees, after Subaru's remark, that "Damn, you're right."
- Guessed Not-Satella was an elf, though he was only half right.
- Felt's knife saved his life after his club was blocked and Elsa struck him.
- Elsa said he was strong enough to let her stand on his club.
- Felt has reason to be sad about a person; Felt considers Rom her grandfather figure and only family.

Secret:
- Knew Felt planned to discuss the price of the stolen item with someone; as soon as he heard Subaru, he had all the reason to throw Subaru out, but did not.
- Hid what looked like a stash behind the counter.
- Believes Subaru has more to thank himself for than Rom; he feels the thanks should go the other way, though he says he would not call his feelings "thanks."

Speech:
- Gruff, teasing, and informal: "You sure like to run your mouth, don't you? Just who do you think you have to thank for getting this far? Woe is me."
- "Why does everybody have to insult the drinks?!"
- "I'm showing you some kindness here…!"
- "My boys are just fine."
- "Then you're out of luck!"
- "What are you doing?! Are you trying to kill me?!"
- "Don't think you can fool me with your funny moves!"
- "This is...this is my face. How did you do that?"
- "This picture…"
- "It's a magic user we're dealing with. I can't really make any moves. Don't be so hasty."
- "All right, I'm going!"
- "It looks like she's starting to get pushed back."
- "If you want to dance that much then I'll make you dance a fine dance, so give it your best shot!"
- "What the hell is this?!"
- "I don't know who's going to win this anymore, so if we just wait around we're going to miss our chance. You understand, right, Felt?"
- "Did we get her?!"
- "Why are you in such a hurry, kid? You're all sweaty, you know. Live strong and take care of yourself."
- "To the giant rats…?" / "To the great white whale…?" / "To our most honorable great dragon…?" (asked at the door before unlocking)
- "I forgot to tell you before, but thank you for the milk."
- "I wouldn't call the way I feel about it 'thanks,' but…if either of us is to thank the other, it should be me, rather than you."
- "…Felt, I don't think he's lying."
- "It could be my client. It does seem a little early, though."
- "Who...you...callin' baldy..."
- "The way I see it, the negotiations lean in favor of the kid. No offense to your employer, but it looks like you're going to have to bring them their money back."
- "That's a really bad habit of you baby boomers." (on blaming others)
- Calls young people's habit of blaming others "a really bad habit of you baby boomers."
- "Is it the badge really worth more than the metia, or worth more than money can buy?"
- "The metia is ...", "Damn, you're right."
- "I'm not joking."
- "Drink." (when pushing liquor to Subaru)

entities.name: Elsa
entities.description:
Elsa, known as the "Bowel Hunter": a black-haired, black-clothed kukri-wielding mercenary who is seductive, sensual, and feared in the capital. She has thin red lips, a serene smile, and a black coat over a black skintight outfit. She was raised in the slums of the capital.

Personality:
- Seductive and sensual in every move; her appearance and traits are described as seductive, and she has an aura of gorgeousness and eroticism.
- Seemingly at ease while doing business.
- Cold, deliberate, and murderous; has cold murderous intent.
- Keeps a serene smile unchanged even while wielding a blade.
- Bored and uninterested in Subaru's antics; her tone toward Subaru is one of pity.
- Enjoys wounded prey and licks her lips erotically with a look of ecstasy when facing them; finds the pain of others wonderful and enjoys her own fights.
- Addicted to fighting; feels ecstasy when hurt.
- Views people as useless things to be discarded when they fail her, and feels no guilt in killing.
- Treats her attacks as satisfying; says "That one was very satisfying."
- Fierce and proud in combat; does not hesitate and is hard to surprise.
- Dislikes being called a girl, noting it has been a very long time since someone called her that.
- Calls herself an enjoyable opponent's challenger and says she never thought she'd meet such an enjoyable opponent.
- Believes "I can't just let myself be in a position to be talked down on price, you know? It's the wisdom of the weak."

Wants:
- Her employer's badge, but she is not the one who wants it; she is acting for her employer.
- To end Subaru's life and send him to meet the angels.
- To face Reinhard at full force, without him holding back, and to taste the legendary sharpness of his sword.
- To thank her employer, who gave her this job.
- To keep her hunger from being unsatisfied; refuses to surrender, saying she would not bear her hunger and move on.
- To kill everyone in the room and pick up the badge from the sea of blood afterward.
- Was counting everything on one strike, aiming for Subaru's stomach.

Knows:
- Her employer wants to pay very little for the badge, and her employer does not actually need the badge, so she has no reason to beg for reconsideration.
- Her employer gave her a little extra in case the other party had second thoughts about the price, so she has a little more to offer.
- Her employer's estimates may have been a little off.
- Believes Subaru offered more money than her.
- Originally said she would pay ten blessed gold coins.
- Views Reinhard as a perfect specimen-like opponent and a starving predator's prey.
- Was sure she only had two fangs; Subaru is wrong to think she has only two of her fangs.
- Her fighting philosophy: "If I lose my fangs, I'll fight with my nails. If I lose my nails, I'll fight with my bones. If I lose my bones, I'll fight with my life. That is how I, the Bowel Hunter, do things."
- Her coat has a formula woven into it that can ward off magic a single time.
- Spirit mages are pretty frightening if you make enemies of them.
- Her employer does not need the badge; she would only be at fault if she had made a mistake herself.
- Subaru considers her a vile woman.
- She has Felt's blood on her hands; she was involved in the theft with Felt, per Subaru's reasoning.
- She has a deep, frozen voice when she is serious.
- She has killed people in the cellar (Subaru, Rom, and Felt), and made sure no one was left alive to tell what happened.
- She is the Bowel Hunter, a name given to her based on the way she kills.
- She is well known in the capital as a dangerous individual; she appears to be more of a mercenary.
- She has thin red lips and a sensual smile; her eyes are fixed and filled with murderous intent.
- She kills by opening stomachs, which she says is her speciality; she has never opened the stomach of a spirit before.
- She can be killed by Subaru's knee; she was struck in the stomach by Subaru's knee in one fight.
- Her weapons are kukris; she draws a second kukri from her waist for surprise attacks and a third knife in some fights.
- Her abilities step out of the realm of human possibility; she moves about the room as though ignoring gravity, kicking off from walls and ceiling.
- Her fighting style is attack and retreat; she uses her elbow and long legs in attacks.
- She can be spotted by Subaru's cell phone camera; a flash lit up the cellar, and she was captured on Subaru's cell phone camera.
- She is strong enough to deflect projectiles with her blade.
- Her ability to dodge is superhuman; she dodges swings with the least amount of movement necessary.
- She can be hit with the blunt side of Subaru's blade.
- She has been a mercenary for a long time and has many fights behind her.
- Subaru fears her, and considers running into her as certain death.

Secret:
- Her employer does not actually need the badge.
- She is the one who ensured no one was left alive after negotiations broke down, and she killed Subaru twice.
- She has a cold, murderous intent set into motion when Subaru said he was with "them."

Speech:
- Speaks with a calm, sensual, sometimes bored tone.
- Uses playful, mocking, and pitying phrases: "Well, don't you sound all high and mighty when you're out of my striking range?"
- Lines she has said: "Twenty coins, exactly." "My employer doesn't actually need that badge, so I don't have any reason to beg you to reconsider." "I'll give this back. I don't need it anymore." "This is my first time in mortal combat with a giant." "I'll just take that." "I'll just kill everyone here, and then I'll pick that badge up from the sea of blood afterward." "You weren't able to do your job. Do you really expect me not to throw away something that's useless to me?" "No, no, no, no, no. There's no way. You're kidding me, right? ….Just what the hell was that?" "It's just as they say…or rather, you're more than what everyone says you are." "No… This is wonderful, wonderful! You had better show me a good time!" "In that case, I'll just have to have you forsake your ideals." "Slowly, slowly, slowly, ever so slowly your body will lose its heat and you will go cold." "One day, I will open the stomachs of everyone here, so take care of your bowels for me until then!" "I see. I understand what's going on now." "That's a nice attitude you have there. I can't say I dislike it. ...So, how much did that boy over there say he would pay for it?" "I can't just let myself be in a position to be talked down on price, you know? It's the wisdom of the weak."

entities.name: Felt
entities.description:
Felt: a young blond thief from the capital's slums with red, rabbit-like eyes and a mischievous canine tooth, who steals Satella's badge and trades in stolen goods.

Personality:
- Friendly and bragging about her exploits, but cold, cautious, and suspicious around Subaru when money is not clearly involved.
- Sharp, defensive, and greedy; does not respond to anything unless it would lead to money.
- Resolute and bold, with a selfish streak; a lone wolf who insists she can make it on her own.
- Small and thin, but strong-willed and stubborn; looks about twelve or thirteen and might pass for fourteen.
- Hates the slums and the losers who live there, and refuses to accept that their attitudes cannot be helped.
- Persistent and does everything she can to find weaknesses in others and get more out of them.
- Trusts Old Man Rom completely, with an unshakable trust built over long years.
- Has a mischievous grin that becomes a villainous smile, later turning into something refreshingly triumphant.

Wants:
- Money, and to leave the slums and escape the circumstances of her orphaned childhood.
- To get the best possible deal for the badge, and to make the badge sell for more than the metia.
- Something more than the slums can offer; she thinks twenty blessed gold coins would bring her dream closer to coming true.

Knows:
- Felt is the thief who supposedly took Satella's badge.
- Felt has made plans with Rom to bring something valuable in later today.
- Felt usually takes stolen things to the loot cellar to get them tagged.
- Felt stole a jeweled badge, a dragon-adorned badge, that she holds against her chest and keeps in her breast pocket.
- Felt stole the badge because someone asked her to, in exchange for ten blessed gold coins.
- Felt said she told Rom she was going to bring something big and did not want anyone else present.
- Felt arrived late, saying she was being tailed by someone persistent and took a long time to lose them.
- Felt sleeps at a place Subaru has pinned down, her living place in the slums.
- Felt's meet-up point with Elsa is Rom, and Rom is where she would have a bodyguard if things went south.
- Felt has a badge that she says is no ordinary badge, and that she went through a lot of trouble to get it.
- Felt is accustomed to being hugged and rustled by Rom, and says she is not happy about being called a little kid.
- Felt has been together with Rom since she was a little girl and is not suited to joining gangs, according to Rom.
- Felt is an orphan with no surname, and does not know her own birthday.
- Felt is about fifteen years old by her own estimate.
- Felt can run like the wind and has the protection of the wind.
- Felt is very fast and dexterous, quickly moving her fingers to show off.
- Felt carries a small knife that appears suddenly, meant to show she can defend herself.
- Felt has strength in her legs and is able to fight.
- Felt would be killed by Elsa if Subaru did not act on the fourth time around.
- Felt stole Satella's badge in all three previous iterations.
- Felt is the person who negotiated with Elsa in the loot cellar, where she probably asked for too much, causing negotiations to break down.
- Felt is the one who gives Subaru chances to talk through Rom.
- Felt was cut down by Elsa's blade in the second death, together with Subaru and Rom.

Secret:
- Felt stole the badge and ran away, leaving Subaru for dead while he was being assaulted by thugs.
- Felt's cause of death in the second loop: she was cut down by Elsa's blade across the chest, from her left shoulder to her right underarm.
- Felt claims she has never seen Rom lose a fight, but her words express trust in him, possibly to dispel her own doubts.

Speech:
- Speaks in a friendly tone and brags about her exploits, but turns sharp and defensive when suspicious.
- "Oh, so you're a customer."
- "You've got good eyes there."
- "Don't worry. There's no way Old Man Rom can lose! Ever since I can remember, I've never seen Rom lose a fight!"
- "Are you an idiot? Pay attention and get out of the way! You want to die?!"
- "I said, cut it out!!"
- "Well damn, I just don't get you."
- "Ha! Cut the act! I'm the one who's backed in a corner here."
- "Damn it, I've been had!"
- "Burn in hell… Damn it…"
- "You get too greedy and you'll die! No, like, seriously."
- "Th-that hurts… Let go…"
- "It's F-Felt…"
- "What's with you?"
- "Whoah!"

entities.name: Kadomon
entities.description: Has a strong build and a characteristically stern expression; is nothing more than a simple merchant.

entities.name: Subaru Natsuki
entities.description:
Subaru Natsuki, a nearly seventeen-year-old third-year public high school truant from Japan, summoned to another world. He has short black hair and average height, neither short nor tall. He is a bit muscular, as if he had been working out, and wears a cheap gray tracksuit that suits him well. He has small irises, so the whites of his eyes stand out. His eyes are downcast, so he does not have a very aggressive or championing look, and he looks average enough to be quickly lost in a crowd.

Personality:
- Extremely ordinary, and tends to run away from decisions he does not like; he is a bit better than your average Joe at running away from things he did not like.
- Acts overly energetic, partly to cover up his previous mistake.
- Cannot separate himself from the fear of death; repeatedly thinks "I'm scared."
- Expression twists into a fiendish smile when he overpowers an opponent.
- Held back the urge to lecture onlookers, thinking "If you realized I was back there, then you should have gone to the guards!"
- Cannot let any minute go to waste.
- Feels jealous of Reinhard's composure and acknowledges that Reinhard acted purposefully to defuse tension.

Wants:
- To save her, and to find a way to save you.
- Wishes that she, at least, will be safe.
- To cling to his relationship with the girl and not let go.
- To learn her name.
- To get information from the spirits about what he is looking for.
- To hurry to the loot cellar, as the situation has not gotten any better.
- To ask whether he should get some kind of reward.

Knows:
- He was born on Earth, the third planet in the solar system, to a middle-class family in the nation of Japan.
- His unexcused absences piled up until he became a bona fide truant. He believes he is now a high school dropout.
- Much of his free time as a truant was spent swinging a sword.
- Has a grip strength of over seventy kilograms of force and can bench eighty kilos.
- Finishes opponents with kicks, elbows, and a suplex.
- Cannot read any of the signs.
- Cannot mention the name "loot cellar" outside of the slums, so relies completely on his memory to navigate.
- Last time he came to the loot cellar he was talking with Satella and his eyes were on her most of the time, so he does not remember the way very well.
- Spent nearly two hours running around the deepest part of the slums before finding the loot cellar.
- Is forever broke and has no money.
- Owes a debt to the girl and considers her his one precious connection in this world.
- The spirits disappeared before he could ask them anything.
- Wonders whether eating the fruit of knowledge would save him.
- Has a heart that beats louder and louder, pulse that quickens, hands that grow heavy, a dry mouth, and ringing ears when facing the greatest sin right in front of him.
- Checks that men he fights have not died before leaving an alley.

Secret:
- His only ability is time travel via his own death. He will die as many times as it takes to save her.
- He flicks a rare notched ten-yen coin in the air when he is at a loss.
- He was struck speechless by the gravity of his mistake after learning the spirits had disappeared.
- After the wound that killed him, he does not look at the person who killed him because it doesn't matter anymore.

Speech:
- Introduces himself as "Subaru Natsuki! The ignorant and unintelligent, forever and everlastingly penniless! Nice to meet you!"
- "My name is Subaru Natsuki! I know there's a ton of things you want to say and a ton of things you want to ask, but before all of that let me confirm just one thing!"
- "I totally just saved your life right now from that terrible weapon, didn't I? We okay so far?"
- "So, are we okay?!" (forms an O and a K with his upper body; "OK" means everything's fine)
- "I want you to tell me your name."
- "I'm going to… find a way to save you."
- "But seriously, what the hell is going on?"
- "This has got to be one of _those_ …"
- "This is really going to be a problem."
- "This is really, really not good."
- "Now it's one-on-one! Come at me with all you've got!"
- "Not good enough!"
- "Don't underestimate the free time of a truant!"
- "If I accidentally kill you, don't hate me too much for this, but I've always wanted to try doing a suplex on someone without mats!"
- "Hmph! Well that was easy! In this world, evil never triumphs!"

entities.name: The Waste Heat of the Beginning
entities.description: Prologue of Volume 1 of Re:Zero -Starting Life in Another World-, in which Subaru Natsuki lies facedown on the ground, unable to move or feel his fingers.

entities.name: Wounded Man
entities.description: The narrator, who is dying. He repeatedly feels that it is 'hot, hot, hot' and mistakes the pain for heat. He coughs up and vomits blood, which froths at the edges of his mouth. His vision is hazy, and he sees the ground in front of him stained red. He says, 'You've…got to be kidding me… All of this is mine?' He feels as though all the blood in his body has spilled out. His fingertips find a large, clean, deep gash in his stomach that runs through his torso and has almost sliced him in half, held together only by bits of skin. He understands he has 'run right into a checkmate in the chess game of his life.' His consciousness falls away, but he seizes it and pulls it back to buy more time. He does not look at his killer's face because it no longer matters to him. His one wish is that she, at least, would be safe. He weakly reaches for the woman, lightly grasps her powerless white hand with his bloodstained grip, and tells her, 'I'm going to…find a way to save you.'

entities.name: Woman
entities.description:
A woman whose voice rings like bells, addressed as 'baru?' in the text (the text does not state whether that is her name). Wife of the shop owner and mother of the little girl.

Personality:
- Beautiful, with fine features and a gentle demeanor.
- Smiles while looking a bit unsure of how to react.
- Scolds and berates her husband when he calls Subaru and Satella 'beggars'.

Wants:
- Wishes for the Wounded Man to be safe (as felt by the Wounded Man).
- Came to the shop to say hello to her husband.

Knows:
- Explained how she, her daughter, Subaru, and Satella came to meet.

Secret:
- None stated.

Speech:
- Says, 'Just you wait…'.
- With a short scream, she crumples onto the carpet of blood right beside the Wounded Man.
- Her white hand falls powerless, then her fingers move slightly to accept his hand.

entities.name: Black-Booted Attacker
entities.description: An unidentified person whose black boot descends into the red pool of fresh blood. The Wounded Man does not see this person's face. The text states that this person was probably the one who killed him.

entities.name: Carpet of Blood
entities.description: A red pool of fresh blood on the ground, spilled from the Wounded Man. The ground in front of him is stained red, and the woman lands upon it.

entities.name: wallet
entities.description: Subaru Natsuki's wallet is in his pocket. It holds all the cash he owns, enough for a small shopping spree under normal circumstances, but in this situation he effectively has no money. It also holds membership cards from various video rental stores. He found it where it should be after he woke up, and it is in his possession.

entities.name: rare notched ten-yen coin
entities.description:
A rare notched ten-yen coin belongs to Subaru Natsuki. He flicks it in the air. It cannot be used as money in this currency system, which is completely different.

Subaru used the coin in a magic trick. It vanished from his right hand and reappeared between the fingers of his left hand. He called it special and gave it to a little girl as a present.

entities.name: gray tracksuit
entities.description: A cheap gray tracksuit worn by Subaru Natsuki. It suits him well. It is unwashed. It is his favorite. It is stained with blood from his cuts.

entities.name: passersby
entities.description: Crowd of people passing by who look at Subaru Natsuki out of the corners of their eyes as if he were something strange they had never seen. None of them have black hair or wear tracksuits. They have blond, red, brown, blue, or green hair, and they wear armor, black robes, or costumes a dancer might wear. They stare openly at him.

entities.name: Earth
entities.description: The third planet in the solar system; Subaru Natsuki was born here.

entities.name: Japan
entities.description: Subaru Natsuki's middle-class family lives in this nation. It is a peaceful country. Subaru lived his years there lazily.

entities.name: Alley off the main road
entities.description: Subaru sits against a wall in an alley just off the main road.

entities.name: Main road
entities.description:
Main road near the alley, where Subaru sits.
Roads are well paved.
Subaru was about to walk onto this road, but three men in the alley block his way.
The girl turned toward this road after leaving Subaru and the men.
The thugs ran out onto this road after leaving the alley.
The girl stood here, unsure where to go next.
Many people pass by here. The characters planned to question people here about a place like the one Subaru described.
A bustling road. Subaru and Satella reached it about ten minutes after walking back. The unnamed kid is on the other side.
Subaru, Satella, and the little girl walked along this road through waves of people.
A fruit shop stands on one side of this road.
This road is full of hustle and bustle. From Subaru and Satella's street, it seems like a far-off dream.
Subaru and Satella's street is not far from this road.
Full of people. Lizard carts pass by, and pedestrians fill the full width of the street. It is bright, daytime, and not very hot.

entities.name: Crowd of onlookers
entities.description: A crowd of onlookers giving open stares to the young man (Subaru).

entities.name: Oxcart-like vehicle
entities.description: An oxcart-like vehicle pulled by a giant lizard-like thing, which crossed in front of Subaru.

entities.name: Giant lizard-like thing
entities.description: A giant lizard-like creature that pulls an oxcart-like vehicle.

entities.name: fantasy world
entities.description: Fantasy world to which Subaru was summoned. Medieval-like setting; no mechanical things seen so far. Commerce is handled in a currency of gold, silver, and copper coins.

entities.name: fruit stand
entities.description: Stand where Subaru's first contact, a merchant, was found. The merchant wasn't all that welcoming.

entities.name: merchant at a fruit stand
entities.description: Subaru's first contact in the fantasy world. Was not all that welcoming to Subaru.

entities.name: cell phone
entities.description:
Subaru's cell phone is a compact, thin, white flip phone with a screen, a camera, and an embedded jewel. He believes it is worthless in this world. He also thinks it is a valuable trump card for bartering, since it is probably unique here.

Its camera captures a flash and shutter sound. It freezes a slice of time and seals it inside the device. It can shoot nine frames per second in continuous mode, with a loud mechanical sound and a bright white flash. The phone was found where it should be after Subaru woke up.

The phone is worth about twenty blessed gold coins, and collectors may pay more. It is the only one of its kind in the world. Felt and Subaru are negotiating over it, and Subaru plans to trade it for Satella's badge. Rom once put it back on the counter. Subaru used it on Felt and Elsa, and it currently shows an image of Rom's face.

entities.name: cup of instant ramen
entities.description: Subaru's belonging; bought from a convenience store, pork bone and soy sauce flavor.

entities.name: bag of crispy snacks
entities.description: Subaru's belonging; bought from a convenience store, corn soup flavor.

entities.name: sneakers
entities.description: Subaru's sneakers are two years old and well-worn, with zero damage.

entities.name: cash
entities.description: Subaru's cash from his original world; cannot be used in the fantasy world.

entities.name: gold, silver, and copper coins
entities.description: Currency used for commerce in the fantasy world.

entities.name: large lizard cart
entities.description: Large lizard carts pulled by giant lizards, seen passing by. Appears to use animals in the same way as in Subaru's world.

entities.name: giant lizards
entities.description: Giant lizards that pull large lizard carts. People pay no attention to them, suggesting they are normal in this world.

entities.name: half-humans
entities.description: Beings including people with dog ears, cat ears, and lizardman-like features. Considered normal by the people around them, as no one pays attention to them.

entities.name: crispy snacks
entities.description: Pack of crispy snacks Subaru had, of which he ate half. It was his only source of food.

entities.name: convenience store
entities.description:
Subaru was returning from a location when he was summoned to another world.
He held a bag in his hand. It was as full as it had ever been.
The bag belongs to Subaru. He puts his empty snack bags in it.
He planned to use the bag to block a hit.

entities.name: Excalibur
entities.description: Legendary sword that Subaru expected to receive but did not.

entities.name: large man
entities.description: A man with a large build. He grabbed Subaru firmly by the shoulder, pulled him back into the alley, and threw him back. He is the leader of the three men who block the alley exit, and they move as though this is not the first time they have done this.

entities.name: two buddies
entities.description: Two of the large man's buddies. They stand behind the large man in a way that blocks Subaru from exiting the alley onto the main road. They move as though this is not the first time they have done this.

entities.name: alley
entities.description:
Narrow alleys connect to the main road. Subaru fights three men in several alleys. Some descriptions describe the same alley.

- A narrow alley off the main road where Subaru is pinned and attacked by three men with a knife. The men block his exit to the main road. The girl runs into it, toward a dead end, and then disappears.
- Subaru is alone there with the girl and her cat after the thugs flee into the main road.
- A dim alley where Subaru is attacked. The girl's silver hair sparkles in its light.
- The girl stands at its entrance, unfazed, with her eyes closed while talking to lesser spirits. A wall is there.
- The thief ran through it while the thugs stomped on Subaru.
- Subaru and Satella walk back through it, guided by the crowd's sounds, to reach the main road.
- Subaru fights the three men here. The thugs are slammed against a wall. Subaru checks that none died, then leaves unscathed.
- A silent alley where Subaru meets Dumb, Dumber, and Dumbest. Subaru's yell breaks the silence.
- A dry, tense alley where Subaru faces three thugs.
- Subaru and Satella search for under an hour and end up here for a reason they discover during the search.
- Subaru wanders into a familiar alley, possibly where he first met Satella. Felt and Not-Satella may appear here.
- Subaru exits this alley after talking with Reinhard. It connects to the main street.
- Subaru is left here after falling and wonders if he will be abandoned.
- A narrow, dark alley deep in the slums with puddles. Subaru hits his back against a wall here.
- A dark alley in the deepest slums, full of rotten garbage stench. Subaru met Elsa here.
- A negotiation scene takes place here. A cell phone's flash passes through it.
- Not-Satella found Subaru here and healed him.
- Subaru saw icicles move faster here than those used against Elsa.
- Subaru first met Reinhard here with Dumb, Dumber, and Dumbest.
- Reinhard refers to something that happened here as "what happened in the alley."
- Reinhard met Subaru here.

entities.name: Thug
entities.description:
Group of thugs, several men in their twenties, who prey on people in alleys and on the main street.

Personality:
- Scornful and ridiculing, with mean faces and dirty appearances that reflect the meanness of their personalities
- Not half-humans, but certainly not saints
- Small-time villains who do not fear Subaru and keep up their taunting
- Proud, and sore losers
- Hesitate when yelled at, and stand angrily in the way

Wants:
- Demand that Subaru give them everything he has on him, promising no one needs to get hurt
- Get revenge on Subaru after being beaten

Knows:
- Previously made comments about Satella's clothes, saying she was dressed pretty well
- Called Reinhard 'master swordsman'
- Were involved in the incident on the main street

Speech:
- "What the hell is he going on about?"
- "I don't know, but I'm pretty sure he's making fun of us. Let's kill 'im."
- "Who're you to act all fair and square with that surprise attack?! You little punk!"
- "If you were that scared, you should have just said so!"
- "Don't talk all big if you're just gonna bend over!"
- "If he's going to do as we say, that just makes it easier on us, right? But what a coward, huh?"
- Said it was three-on-one last time and they still lost, and that even sore losers would show more shame when they wail.
- Subaru named them "dumb, dumber, and dumbest."

entities.name: compulsory event
entities.description: An encounter with thugs, which Subaru considers a compulsory event. Encountering thugs is described as a way to show the dangers of everyday life and is not considered an unusual plot development.

entities.name: big man in front
entities.description: One of the men in the alley; Subaru's straight jab from his right hand collides with his nose. Falls to the ground after being punched.

entities.name: another of the men (kicked man)
entities.description: Caught off guard by Subaru; kicked on the side of the head and slammed into the wall of the alley. Said "Let's kill 'im," replied another.

entities.name: last man standing
entities.description: The last of the men in the alley, holding a glinting knife in his hand. Subaru bent forward to beat him when his eyes centered on the knife. Subaru prostrated himself before him.

entities.name: glinting knife
entities.description: Held in the hand of the last man standing; glinting.

entities.name: Subaru's right fist
entities.description: Subaru's right hand fist; collided with the big man's nose and was cut on one of the man's front teeth, causing bleeding.

entities.name: Man with the knife
entities.description:
A thug who attacked Subaru in an alley. He is one of the men who fled the alley after the cat appeared.

Personality:
- Aggressive and threatening, and quick to turn violent.
- Overcome with fear when he sees the palm-size cat.

Wants:
- Subaru's strange-looking clothes and shoes.
- To kill Subaru.

Knows:
- Believes the palm-size cat is a spirit mage.
- Believes Subaru may be a magic user or nobility, but says he doesn't care.

Speech:
- "Stop moving, you whelp!"
- "After we make sure you can't move we're going to take everything you've got. That's what you get for acting tough, you punk…"
- "I don't care if you're a magic user or nobility or whatever! I've had enough. We're gonna kill you! Do you really think you can win a two-on-one fight?!"
- "Y-you're a spirit mage?!"

entities.name: Thug with bleeding nose
entities.description: One of the two men Subaru thought he had defeated. Was holding his bleeding nose and is back on his feet. Says: 'I dunno what you're going on about, but shut your trap! You've really done it now!' Is in surprisingly good condition despite Subaru's punch.

entities.name: Thug shaking his head
entities.description: One of the two men Subaru thought he had defeated. Was shaking his head back and forth and is back on his feet. Is in surprisingly good condition despite Subaru's punch. Participates in beating Subaru.

entities.name: knife
entities.description:
Summary of the knife descriptions:

- A knife held by a mob man, its tip aimed at Subaru's arm, ready to strike. It scares Subaru into not fighting.
- A knife about to come down on Subaru.
- A knife whose tip moves closer to Subaru, making his death feel real.
- A knife carried by the man with the knife, who tried to pull it out as Subaru approached.
- A knife carried by the skinny mob man. It caused Subaru's earlier defeat.
- A knife stuck in Subaru's back after Dumber stabbed him. It went deeper when Dumb turned Subaru over.
- A weapon held by one of the three men, Dumb, Dumber, or Dumbest.
- A weapon carried by Dumber, seen as the most likely to cause a fatal wound.
- Elsa's knife, used to strike upward at Not-Satella's chest. Its blade pierced her ice shield but was stopped by it.
- A plain knife taken from Elsa's breast pocket. Thrown at Felt's back, but knocked off course by the round table.
- Elsa's knife, bent completely during her last attack on Subaru. Thrown at Reinhard but missed.

entities.name: strange-looking clothes and shoes
entities.description: Subaru's clothes and shoes, which the man with the knife wants to take ('Then those strange-looking clothes and shoes'll do just fine').

entities.name: Alley Attackers
entities.description: Men attempting murder and robbery in the alley. One speaks in a stammering, pleading tone to Subaru, claiming he has no money or valuables and that he doesn't have a cent on him. The men intend to take Subaru's strange-looking clothes and shoes, saying 'Then those strange-looking clothes and shoes'll do just fine,' and tell Subaru to stay down and be food for the alley rats. One of them holds a knife about to come down on Subaru. They suddenly looked up when the girl dashed into the alley.

entities.name: Blond Girl
entities.description: A small girl with longish blond hair, red eyes showing a strong will, and one canine tooth sticking out that makes her look like a prankster. Seems more cheeky than anything else; Subaru felt she would look pretty cute if she smiled. Wears well-worn clothes and has an unclean appearance. Flustered-sounding voice. Dashed into the alley yelling 'Hey! Out of the way! Out of the way! I'm talking to you! Move!' Stumbled upon the attempted murder and robbery in the act. Said 'Whoa! You look like you're in quite a pinch there, but sorry! I've got my hands full right now! Good luck! Live life to the fullest!' and did not help Subaru.

entities.name: alley rats
entities.description: Rats in this world, mentioned by the attackers as the food Subaru would become if left to lie down. Subaru hoped they are not big like monster rats.

entities.name: the girl
entities.description:
Composite persona sheet covering several girls Subaru meets in the alley and afterward. The source descriptions do not clearly identify them as one character, so each fact is kept and attributed by context.

Girls in the alley scene, including a silver-haired girl with an unnamed cat companion, a magic user, a girl with violet eyes, a spirit-speaking girl, and a refugee-minded girl, plus a lost crying girl, a girl Subaru helped, and an unnamed girl Subaru wants to see again. Also a girl mentioned by Emilia in connection with an old man.

Personality:
- Racing, confident, and dignified, with a lovely, bewitching presence, though the confidence is often an ongoing act.
- Cautious and does not let her guard down.
- Cold, emotionless voice; cold stare that sharpens when Subaru errs.
- Apologetic in gesture while moving without slowing down.
- Wants to help others; becomes anxious and concerned about Subaru.
- Hesitant to lie, and desires a positive outlook.
- Flustered and hopeless when her confidence is stripped away.
- Proud smile; blushes and goes silent when embarrassed.
- Pleads with all her heart when desperate.
- Irritated when she believes she is being misled.
- Used terrible reasoning to show she was not worse off for saving Subaru, but did not complain or seek an apology despite having every right to blame him.
- Anguished over decisions, moaning with many "but"s, "still"s, and "if"s before conceding.
- Wears clothing that looks expensive.
- Stares at Subaru as if he were a rare animal, does not find the situation funny, and sizes him up.
- Believes Subaru is from a high-ranking family, and that his black hair and dark eyes in Lugunica mean he can live a life of luxury.
- Comes to her own conclusions and does not press him for answers she thinks he cannot share.

Wants:
- Her stolen thief item back, which she absolutely cannot give up.
- Her stolen badge back; was owed a badge stolen by a culprit who ran away.
- Something stolen from her returned quickly; in a hurry to get it back.
- To help others.
- Subaru to pay her back, though she took nothing from him in return.
- To see Subaru's smile (regarding the unnamed girl Subaru wants to meet again).

Knows:
- The thief who stole from her is "down farther ahead."
- Subaru's claims that he knows nothing; she says she has never seen Subaru before in her life.
- Lesser spirits do not have the clear awareness that regular spirits have.
- It took some time for the spirits to appear.
- She searched with Subaru for a little under an hour.
- Subaru's name is unusual.
- Subaru's black hair and dark eyes are common traits of refugees from the south.
- Subaru is not just simply a foreigner in a foreign land.
- Subaru's clothes are magnificent craftsmanship.
- Subaru's fingers, skin, and hair are not those of a commoner; his muscles do not look like the product of hard labor.
- Subaru looks to be in pretty good shape.
- Subaru has a curious air about him.
- Her cat Puck.
- The unnamed old man's situation that Reinhard does not think he can ignore.
- Appearance: expensive-looking clothes; silver hair she touches when troubled; hair voice; white fingers; beautiful and bewitching violet eyes; palm-size cat on extended left hand; magic user who hits with clumps of ice.
- Subaru owes her a debt and considers her his one precious connection in this world.
- Subaru's name, and that Subaru is in the unfamiliar area with full confidence that he knows his way around.

Secret:
- Believes the only reason she saved Subaru was for her own ends.
- Her magic and the hair voice are unexplained in the source; she was not really expecting much from the spirits and admitted this was a lie.
- Satella regretted not helping the lost crying girl; Subaru ultimately helped her.

Speech:
- "Hmm… It doesn't look like you're lying. So the one who stole from me is down farther ahead? I've got to hurry…"
- "Wh-wh-what are we going to do? Was this really all just a waste of my time...?"
- "But…really, this isn't looking very good" (in a nowweaker tone).
- "Subaru?" (called out at the end).
- "I've been had! Is that why you stopped me? Are you two working together?!"
- "You're right, one against two sounds like it could be a little tough."
- Calls out "Subaru?" and calls Subaru by name hesitantly.
- Cold, emotionless tone when telling Subaru not to move.
- Says she cannot offer anything in return and does not have a copper piece on her.
- Says she only has a bit more time to spend dealing with Subaru.
- Says that if Subaru is wrong he should just say so, otherwise it will be more embarrassing for her.
- Tells him he doesn't have to think that hard and that she won't question him further if it is something he can't talk about.

entities.name: the men
entities.description:
A group of thugs who pinned Subaru in an alley.

Personality:
- Vulgar and insulting toward Subaru.
- Angry and vengeful; one of them wants Subaru dead.
- Shaken and dumbstruck by the girl's presence.
- Relieved and cowardly once the girl turned away, abandoning Subaru.

Wants:
- To kill Subaru.

Knows:
- The girl's clothes look expensive, and they wonder whether she is nobility.
- They had stolen something, which they realized after seeing the girl.

Speech:
- "Wha… Who do you think you are…?"
- "Hey, what she's wearing looks expensive. You think she's nobility? Wait, huh…? What we stole?"
- "More like it killed the mood and now I'm even angrier. Don't think you'll get to die a pleasant death!"

entities.name: dead end
entities.description: The alley ends at a wall with a wooden plank against it. The girl used the plank to launch herself up. Neither of the two girls was there. Subaru was killed the third time in a completely different place from the alley.

entities.name: end wall
entities.description: The wall at the dead end of the alley. The girl grabbed its top to climb up.

entities.name: wooden plank
entities.description: Set up against the end wall at the dead end; the girl kicked off against it to climb.

entities.name: roof of a surrounding building
entities.description: Roof of one of the buildings surrounding the alley. The girl flung herself onto it and disappeared.

entities.name: silver-haired girl
entities.description:
Silver-haired girl with violet eyes, a noble bearing, and a dangerous, bewitching charm. Her badge was stolen, and she is wary of Subaru.

Appearance:
- Beautiful, with long silver hair in braids that reach down to her hips. The hair swayed as she moved and sparkled in the dim light of the alley.
- Her silver hair tumbles down off her shoulder when she tilts her head.
- Violet eyes that shone with intelligence.
- Soft features with both youthful elements and mature beauty.
- About one head shorter than Subaru, around five feet, three inches tall.
- Wears clothes with white as the base color, simple and not ornate, which emphasize her presence.
- Wears a white cloak embroidered with a bird of prey, adding to her impression of majesty.
- Her voice is like silver bells.
- Surrounded by faint lights that look like fireflies.

Personality:
- Noble and majestic, with a dangerous and bewitching charm.
- Intelligent, and her presence makes men and Subaru shaken.
- Angry and red in the face when provoked; Subaru finds her really cute when angry.
- In a hurry, speaks with machine-gun rapidity.
- Uses twisted logic: says Subaru's total ignorance is information that justifies healing him.
- Commands rather than asks.
- Cried out in surprise when Subaru spoke to her, and droplets of tears formed in her eyes. Her flustered state spread to the lights around her, causing them to panic.
- Fidgets when nervous, and looked worried at a request before finding her determination.
- Was surprised that Subaru really does have a good head on his shoulders.
- Claims not to be worried about Subaru.

Wants:
- Her stolen badge back; she is very precious to her.
- Answers to her questions, which is the stated reason she stayed with Subaru until he woke up.
- Subaru to make it up to her.
- Subaru to do the right thing and give back what he stole.

Knows:
- Communicates with lesser spirits.
- Calls the object a "badge."
- The capital is the town with the king's castle; she mentioned the capital several times in earlier conversation.
- Has a cat companion.
- Healed Subaru's wounds and threatened the other men so they will not approach him again.
- Subaru is looking for her around here lately; Rom has not seen her and says he would have remembered silver hair because it stands out in a bad way.
- Has asked Subaru about the stolen badge before, when they had gone through this once already before he passed out.

Secret:
- Not honest with herself, according to the cat.

Speech:
- "I will not stand by and watch any more of your wrongdoing. That is enough."
- "If you stop right now, I'll let you go. In a way, this is my fault for not being cautious. So do the right thing and give back what you stole."
- "There's no way! No way that I'm going to save him, okay?! Okay?!"
- "Don't get any ideas about this," emphasized strongly.
- "Um…okay, yeah. Go right ahead."
- "O-okay…"
- "…I understand. Only if it's something I'm able to do, though."
- "So my wish is…"
- "Go on."
- Drops her voice tone when asking about the stolen badge.
- Warns Subaru that she will not save him again if he gets into a similar situation.

entities.name: white cloak
entities.description: The silver-haired girl wears a white cloak. It has embroidery of a bird of prey, which adds to its majestic look. Satella wears it, and she has rolled down its sleeves.

entities.name: Alley Entrance
entities.description: An alley entrance sits in front of the main road. A silver-haired girl stands there, unsure where to go next.

entities.name: Group of Men
entities.description: A group of men who confronted the girl and Subaru. They pointed to Subaru, still underfoot, and asked if the girl came to rescue him. They claimed they were not involved and blamed the girl who stole from the girl's party ("that girl from before"), saying she jumped off the wall and ran away on the rooftops and is farther back past the wall, probably another three streets down. They pleaded their innocence. Said they did not know what the girl was talking about and that three against one was not fair.

entities.name: Thief Girl
entities.description:
A blond girl who allegedly stole a badge and is also the girl who allegedly stole from the girl. Her name and origin are unknown. She is sort of like a kitten, has a canine tooth that sticks out and is hard to miss, is shorter than the girl, has a pretty flat chest, and is about two or three years younger than the girl.

Knows:
- The men call her "that girl from before."
- She jumped off the wall and ran away on the rooftops.
- The men say she is farther back past the wall, probably another three streets down.
- The girl believes she is ahead and is the one who stole from her.

entities.name: Stolen Precious Item
entities.description: An item stolen from the girl, described as very precious to her. She would give up anything else but cannot give up this item. Its exact form is not described in the text.

entities.name: That Wall
entities.description: A wall the thief girl jumped off of to escape onto the rooftops. The men pointed to it. The thief is farther back past it.

entities.name: Rooftops
entities.description: Area the thief girl ran across after jumping off the wall.

entities.name: Three Streets Down
entities.description: Estimated location where the thief girl probably is, based on her pace, according to the men.

entities.name: unnamed girl
entities.description:
Girl and spirit mage who controls lesser spirits and has ice magic. She is the master of the cat Puck.

Personality:
- Stubborn and hesitant.
- Stands in thought when considering others' words.
- Insists on repaying kindness, even when told it is unnecessary.
- Gets a little excited at seeing spirits for the first time.
- Becomes depressed and powerless when she fails to re-establish contact with lesser spirits.

Wants:
- Thanks Subaru for healing her, though Subaru says he has not done anything deserving of thanks.
- Has a goal that requires going to the capital, and is going on no clues at all.
- Hesitates to involve Subaru: "But if I get him involved..."
- Re-establish contact with the lesser spirits that fled.

Knows:
- Someone stole from her and was heading down the road farther ahead.
- Possesses magic: raises her hand with palm facing outward, causing a series of shining lights to dance in front of it, then fires a fist-size clump of ice that strikes enemies.
- Was trying to control the lesser spirits when they fled, and was dumbstruck when they did.
- Believes the spirits were not dangerous.
- Claims the spirits were only safe because she had them under control.
- Says she would never use Puck for violence.
- Says she would handle Subaru herself if she were going to be violent.
- Puck calls her "master."
- Puck says she is cute when she is stubborn, but that letting stubbornness make her lose sight of her goals is foolish.
