Speech:
- "I've got to hurry..."
- "Still, this situation is one I can't just ignore."
- "But if I get him involved..."
- Scolds Subaru for not taking his actions seriously, saying that if he had done the same to an inexperienced spirit mage, the spirits could have gone berserk ("BAM").
- Apologizes, saying it was her first time seeing spirits like that.

entities.name: clump of ice
entities.description: Fist-size clump of ice that shot out of the girl's palm, struck the men with a dull thud, and fell to the ground right beside Subaru. Seemed to have formed heedless of both the season and the laws of physics, and quickly evaporated as if being eaten by the surrounding air. Used as a blunt object for physical damage.

entities.name: shining lights
entities.description: A series of shining lights that began to dance in front of the girl's palm before the ice was fired. No incantation accompanied them.

entities.name: other man
entities.description: Took a real hit from the clumps of ice and got back to his feet. Stands next to the man with the knife and draws out a blunt, club-like object, ready to fight. Angered rather than discouraged by the hits.

entities.name: knocked-out man
entities.description: The third man, hit in a bad spot by the clumps of ice. Remains knocked out.

entities.name: club-like object
entities.description: Blunt, club-like object drawn out by the other man, ready for fighting.

entities.name: palm-size cat
entities.description: Small, palm-size cat that stands upright on its two hind legs. Has gray hair and floppy ears, nearest to an American shorthair apart from its pink nose. Has a tail about the length of its body. Uses its paw to clean its face. Sits on the girl's palm and white fingers. Speaks in a higher-pitched, genderless voice; says, 'When you all stare at me like that, full of expectation, it's uh…kind of embarrassing.' Asks, 'In that case, would two on two be bit more fair?' Seen by the man with the knife as a spirit mage.

entities.name: cat
entities.description:
A palm-size spirit mage cat, companion to the girl (Satella), and her cat.

Personality:
- Light in tone, but much more severe in its response to the thugs
- Not completely serious when making threats
- Senses zero evil intentions from Subaru and considers his reaction natural for a boy like him
- Cute-looking; apologetic on the girl's behalf
- Playful and teasing; laughs and speaks
- Embarrassed when it scratches at Subaru's face, and winks as if seeking confirmation

Wants:
- Keeps the girl safe; threatened to curse the thugs and all of their offspring if they harmed her
- Wants Subaru not to think too strangely of the girl

Knows:
- The girl is not really honest with herself
- The girl's intentions (it spoke about them)
- Its job is the perfect nine-to-five job
- Uses a lot of mana just by materializing
- Returns to the crystal that is its vessel when night falls and prepares for when the sun is out again
- Can change its size

Secret:
- Its name is known to Subaru but is not stated in the text

Speech:
- Says, "Well, if you're going to be this happy about it, I guess it was really worth super-sizing… Don't you think so, too?"
- Gives warnings such as: "Wait. You shouldn't try to stand up just ye—Well…okay"
- Threatens to curse those who harm the girl, not entirely seriously
- Flicks its whiskers with its front paw; scratches and winks as gestures
- Disappears by slipping behind the curtain of the girl's hair after being patted on its back

entities.name: fallen companion
entities.description: A companion of the thugs who had fallen and was picked up by the men as they left the alley.

entities.name: culprit
entities.description: The girl who stole the girl's badge. Ran away very fast and may have some kind of strange protection on her side.

entities.name: badge
entities.description:
- **Satella's badge:** Belonged to Satella and was stolen in broad daylight at a street corner, in a crowd. It is being searched for. Subaru will help find it. Satella wants it back safe and sound, and she fears losing it forever if this chance is missed.
- **The "badge":** Satella calls it a badge. Subaru compares it to police and detective badges but has never seen one like it.
- **Small jeweled badge:** Has a jewel in its center. Supposedly belonged to Satella. Its value is unknown and it may be expensive.
- **Subaru's item:** Was stolen from him. Its value is unknown, and it is unclear whether it looks expensive.
- **Subaru's badge:** Belongs to Subaru and is not currently in his possession. He plans to get it back and then apologize properly.
- **Silver-haired girl's badge:** Brought in by Felt. Belongs to a silver-haired girl who saved Subaru's life and is very precious to her. Subaru has not seen it and will take it back at a big loss.
- **Felt's badge (for the metia):** Felt takes it from her breast pocket and sets it on the table. Subaru wants to trade for it. Felt does not care who wins the bid and will give it to the best offer. Rom says it could fetch a lot, but less than the metia.
- **Felt's badge (for the card):** Subaru wants to trade for it. He tries to take it, but Felt pushes it back.
- **Stolen item Felt holds:** Everyone wants it. Felt believes it is worth more than the metia. Subaru may have to wrestle it from her.
- **Item Felt stole for money:** Stolen at someone's request. Felt plans to sell it for three to five gold coins, by her estimate.
- **Item under a prior agreement:** Felt was commissioned to steal it. Another party has a prior agreement for it and may still want it.
- **Item Felt intends to steal:** Not described further.
- **Not-Satella's badge:** Not-Satella demands its return and calls it very precious. Felt holds it close to her chest, hidden from view. Subaru wants to return it himself. Felt wants to know its real value and was trying to delay Not-Satella from getting it. Felt offers to let Subaru take it.
- **Not-Satella's item:** Belongs to Not-Satella and is stolen by Felt every time.
- **Subaru's cell phone trade:** Subaru plans to exchange his cell phone for an item. Its nature is not described.
- **Item Subaru stole:** Subaru took it from a persistent woman and planned to sabotage her over it.
- **Item Elsa's employer wants:** Subaru is trying to barter for it. The employer planned to pay up to twenty blessed gold coins, which was not enough. The employer does not actually need it.
- **Item Elsa will pick up:** Elsa will collect it from the sea of blood after killing everyone. She considers it useless and will throw it away.
- **Item Subaru was going to get back:** Not described further.
- **Badge Felt stole from Emilia:** Very valuable. Felt took it from her pocket to return it, and Reinhard grabbed the hand holding it. Emilia said Felt did not know its worth.
- **"This badge" (Emilia's):** Emilia suspects it is the reason Reinhard decided to take Felt. Its nature is not described.
- **Object to return:** The speaker told Subaru to take it and leave so it would not be stolen again.
- **Badge stolen by Rom's ally:** Stolen from Subaru. Rom is in league with the thief.

entities.name: unidentified pair
entities.description: A pair of speakers whose conversation Subaru could partly hear while his consciousness was leaving him. Said: '…So, what should we do?' and 'He has…nothing to do with us. That's not enough to kill him. We're going to leave him.' Later asked 'Are you sure?' and answered 'I'm sure!' They have a severe view on the concept of empathy. Their identities are not stated in the text.

entities.name: unidentified voice
entities.description: Speaker located right above Subaru's head while he was lying down, who said: 'Oh, you awake?' Identity is not stated in the text.

entities.name: giant cat
entities.description: A human-size cat with a kind, concerned voice. It told Subaru he shouldn't move because he hit his head and it could not yet say whether it was safe. It offered its lap as a pillow, saying, 'I thought that at least until you woke up, I'd make you feel comfortable. You can thank me later.' It speaks in a terrible falsetto voice, which Subaru asks it to stop using. It says, 'Well, if you're going to be this happy about it, I guess it was really worth super-sizing… Don't you think so, too?' When embarrassed, it scratches at its face and winks.

entities.name: the ground
entities.description: Subaru wakes up lying on hard, textured ground. The ground is stained red with blood. It is in front of Subaru Natsuki. Reinhard planted one foot down with great pressure, and the ground fractured beneath him.

entities.name: stolen badge
entities.description:
Here is a short, combined summary:

A badge was stolen. The silver-haired girl asks Subaru if he knows anything about it. Its importance is implied by Subaru's question about what was lost. A blond-haired girl stole it. Felt took it out of her pocket. Elsa came to buy it, but its owner had already taken it away. It is Subaru's badge. The old man is allegedly in league with the thief.

entities.name: Those Other Guys
entities.description: Men who attacked Subaru in the alley. Were threatened by the girl so heavily that she believes they will not go near Subaru again.

entities.name: girl's silver hair
entities.description: Silver hair that the girl touches when she looks troubled. The cat slipped behind its curtain and disappeared.

entities.name: silver-haired voice
entities.description:
Silver-haired heroine of the work; a voice that speaks jokingly from her silver hair.

Personality:
- Jokes lightly, even about her group's bad luck.

Wants:
- (none stated)

Knows:
- (none stated)

Secret:
- (none stated)

Speech:
- Speaks jokingly, e.g. "Three of us, if you count me... Pretty terrible for us as a group."
- The voice comes from her silver hair.
- The author invites readers to shout, "Silver-haired heroines are awesome!"
- Her name was debated over whether to add "-tan" to it.

entities.name: Cat familiar
entities.description: A cat that pokes at the girl's cheek with its paws. Talks, and is bound by a contract with its master, the girl. Senses no evil intentions from Subaru and does not think his idea is a bad one. Says that with how large the capital is, Subaru's help is way better than going on no clues at all. Supports Subaru in favor of his help. Says it would rather not think of its own master as a fool. Says the sun is starting to set and that if night falls it will not be able to help, and that it is not worried about the girl handling a thug or two but it is better to be safe than sorry. Says it can be called if there is danger. Cannot come out at night, which is implied to be a term of its contract. Speaks in a serious voice when addressing the seriousness of the situation.

entities.name: capital
entities.description: Large capital city where the girl's goals and clues lie. Subaru is there and does not know how to get around. Not-Satella may be walking around, and Reinhard, a guard, would likely have noticed her. Many thefts occur here, showing poor security. Felt is probably being chased by Not-Satella here. Elsa is known as a dangerous person here. Reinhard wandered aimlessly here on his day off. A full moon floats over the city at twilight.

entities.name: crystal vessel
entities.description: A crystal that is the cat spirit's vessel. The cat returns to it when night falls.

entities.name: Town
entities.description: A town that Subaru does not know his way around. Handwritten symbols and road signs are found here and there throughout it.

entities.name: road signs
entities.description: Road signs around the town. Completely illegible to Subaru, so he cannot read them.

entities.name: handwritten symbols
entities.description: Characters and symbols written here and there all around the town. Completely illegible to Subaru. Probably letters for the common language, unless they are 'mystic charms to protect against evil magic' that tended to be popular.

entities.name: lesser spirits
entities.description:
Minor spirits communicated with by a girl who mutters with her eyes closed; faint firefly-like lights.

Personality:
- Panicked and easily swept up in the girl's flustered state.

Wants:
- (none stated)

Knows:
- Beings that, in a state prior to becoming real spirits, start to develop some knowledge.
- If they gain power and self-awareness over time, they become spirits.
- Appear as faint lights like fireflies.
- Described by the girl as "little sparkly things."
- Fled this way and that before scattering and disappearing into the air.
- No longer heed the girl's call.
- Could go berserk if handled by an inexperienced spirit mage, according to the girl.

Secret:
- (none stated)

Speech:
- (none stated)

entities.name: gray cat
entities.description: The girl's gray cat, a spirit that floats in midair and waves its long tail back and forth. Suddenly reappeared right in front of Subaru. Had been present the whole time and takes its job seriously. Has a bit of time left before it has to go. Explained: 'Lesser spirits are beings that, in a state prior to becoming real spirits, start to develop some knowledge. If, over time, they gain power and self-awareness, they'll become spirits like me.'

entities.name: holy ground
entities.description: The area around the silver-haired girl that began to glow. Like holy ground, where the influence of the supernatural is allowed only for what is sanctified. Most people would subconsciously hesitate to interfere with this scene.

entities.name: spirits
entities.description: Spirits that disappeared before Subaru was able to ask them for information about what he is looking for. Lesser spirits do not have the kind of clear awareness that regular spirits have. The girl says it took some time for them to appear.

entities.name: Lugunica
entities.description:
- A country lies farthest east on the continent. The girl says no country lies east of here.
- Subaru is currently in a country where refugees from the south live. They have black hair and dark eyes.
- The girl says Subaru can live a life of luxury here because he has these traits.
- One nation's capital is the largest city in its country.
- Subaru has reached a country's capital. The country is usually peaceful but is now falling into unrest.
- This country lies west of Subaru's claimed home, which is east of Lugunica.

entities.name: Zipang
entities.description: A hidden country to the east, a recurring cliché in otherworldly fiction since times long past. Subaru hopes the current country is his long-yearned-for Zipang. Not much interaction tends to occur between countries, so claims of traveling there tend to be believed.

entities.name: thief
entities.description:
A young female thief who makes her living stealing and is not well off, as her worn clothes show.

Personality:
- Bold; willing to steal in broad daylight in the middle of a crowd, where it is easy to get lost.

Wants:
- Not stated, though she may sell the stolen item.

Knows:
- She ran through an alley while thugs were stomping on Subaru.
- She stole Satella's badge in broad daylight in the middle of a crowd.
- She is getting farther and farther away from Subaru and Satella.

Secret:
- Her identity is unknown to the party; she is unidentified.
- If she sells the stolen item, it would become unrecoverable.

Speech:
- Not stated.

entities.name: Capital City
entities.description: The capital of the unnamed country the characters are in. A town that has the king's castle in it and is a really big place.

entities.name: King's Castle
entities.description: The king's castle, located in the capital town.

entities.name: Satella
entities.description:
**Character 1: Emilia (silver-haired half-elf, Subaru's companion)**

A silver-haired half-elf girl with violet, amethyst-colored eyes and extraordinary beauty. She wears a white robe with a hawk embroidered on it. By Subaru's rough estimate she looks about seventeen or eighteen. Her silver hair dances behind her when she walks.

Personality:
- Incorrigibly kind, though she would never admit it herself. Whether this comes from a curse or some other reason is unclear.
- A big sister figure to Subaru's group, all-too-kind by nature.
- Cannot hide what she truly feels and is soft at the core, too soft even.
- Speaks directly and honestly, too directly and honestly for her own good. If something is twisted or bent, she cannot help but try to set it right.
- Is a girl who could not bring herself to lie for any reason.
- Rarely smiles, and when she does, the reason has nothing to do with Subaru.
- Gets defensive and tense when Subaru uses the name of the Witch of Jealousy.
- Has a personality that makes things complicated when she does the talking.

Wants:
- To get her lost badge back, which she is searching for.
- To help the little girl. She believes helping the girl and getting her badge back are both better than only getting the badge, and says she would have regretted not helping even if they had recovered the badge.
- Proposes approaching the master by saying, "We've had something stolen from us, so if you can find it, please return it to us."
- Believes buying back the stolen item is unfair.
- Insists they search the slums and flatly refuses to ask the police or guards for help, saying, "We can't." She does not think the guards can be made to act over such a small theft. She has other reasons she cannot ask the guards for help and says she can't say why.

Knows:
- The town is the capital of Lugunica, the largest city in the nation, with about three hundred thousand people living there and many others coming and going.
- Her badge is small with a jewel embedded in its center, and she is fairly certain the jewel would not fetch a small amount of money. She does not know the value of the badge, though it is possible she received it from someone else.
- Her badge was stolen in broad daylight, in the middle of a crowd of people. She believes the theft happened "this way" and leads Subaru down the street to the place.
- Her badge was stolen from her at the street corner where Subaru was summoned.
- She believes the people at the loot cellar have no hope of salvation, and thinks the name "cellar" for the loot cellar makes sense if the place is filled only with stolen goods.
- She has seen the woman with long brown hair before and was present when the two were earlier encountered.
- The badge with a jewel is so important to her that she would face danger just to get it back.

Secret:
- She has other reasons she cannot ask the guards for help and cannot say why.
- She admits she would be lying if she said she didn't think Subaru was holding her back in some way.

Speech:
- "Hmph. If you don't understand, that's not my problem. More importantly, we've got to continue our search."
- "Subaru, you…nincompoop."
- "Hey, Subaru… Do you think that kid is lost?"
- "All right. I'll leave it to you." and "W-why are you so surprised?"
- "I don't want be mean…but you're really weak."
- "Let's keep going. But remember, with Puck gone we need to be even more careful than before."
- "You're totally hopeless, but then again, I'm convinced. …All right."
- "I understand that you're happy to be useful for once, but it's really lame when you put so much emphasis on yourself like that."
- "I can't force myself to say something like that, but… Good luck."
- "So…I'll trust you." and "If this all works out I might even think that meeting you was all worth it."
- "I know, I know. I'm not a child. I can take care of myself." (said when Puck looks at her affectionately)
- "Now it'll be just the two of us…but don't get any ideas. I can still use magic, you know."
- "Right. Don't you worry. Just let your big sister handle this. We'll definitely find your mom, okay?"
- "I'm sorry for pushing you so hard, Puck. I'll do my best from here on out, so you just get some rest." (said to Puck)
- "Wait, Subaru…what are you…?"
- "Hmm? What's wrong?"
- "I'm sorry I'm not the one you're looking for." (said kneeling to the little girl)
- Asks: "How did you do that?" and "You really look like you're used to this… Subaru, is your profession taming children?"

---

**Character 2: Puck (spirit, Emilia's companion)**

A small spirit who slips back under Emilia's silver hair and sits on her shoulder. Emilia calls him her partner, and he calls her his "precious daughter."

Personality:
- Protective and affectionate toward Emilia. Wanted to protect her from an "evil-eyed guy hanging around her," meaning Subaru.

Wants:
- Emilia to be careful and not push herself too hard.

Knows:
- Refers to "team tactics," which Emilia does not understand.

Speech:
- "Be careful, don't push yourself too hard, and use your od to call me back out if something happens."
- Remarks on Emilia as his "precious daughter."

---

**Character 3: Subaru (protagonist, as described by others or in his own narration)**

Subaru is described in the text as dusty, dirty, and bloodied, wearing a gray tracksuit. He is penniless along with Emilia. He is summoned to this world and has died several times.

Personality:
- Teases others, and his exaggerated persecution complex is visible to Emilia.
- Acts like a jerk sometimes, but is not the kind of person to lie or do anything without thinking first.
- Is shocked by others' approach to good deeds and gives unexpected replies.

Wants:
- To pay back the person he is in debt to, and hopes to pay her back.
- To reunite with the woman Not-Satella and plans to meet back up with her.
- To keep the little girl from crying.

Knows:
- Subaru thinks the people in the slums likely look at him in pity because of his dusty, dirty, bloodied appearance.
- He believes the woman he calls Satella may be dead. He recalls that Satella fell in a pool of blood.

Secret:
- He dragged the flashback woman into all of this.

Speech:
- "I don't know what you're planning on apologizing for, but I'd rather hear a 'thank you' instead. It would be even better if that thank-you came along with a smile." (said by Emilia to Subaru)
- Called "dummy" by Emilia.
- "Oh, stop being so stupid" (said by Emilia)

---

**Character 4: Satella (alias, cat owner, whisper-named girl)**

A girl who gave her name as "Satella" in a whisper after a silence, and said she does not have a last name. She owns a cat. Her eyes widen in surprise when asked for her name.

Personality:
- Emotionless voice. Distances herself from Subaru more than ever before, and seems to refuse to be called by her name.
- Hostile when Subaru grabs her shoulder. Her white cheeks reddened and she was incredibly angry. She is a thin girl with a thin shoulder, clear eyes, and an emotionless stare.

Wants:
- To be left alone by Subaru.

Knows:
- Her name "Satella" is a fake name revealed to be false.

Speech:
- "I don't know who you are, but what the hell are you thinking, calling someone the same name as that Witch of Jealousy?!"
- Fine with Subaru's plan when it is praised: nods several times.

---

**Character 5: Not-Satella (the woman Subaru wants to meet)**

Her real name is not revealed in the text.

Personality:
- Did not trust Subaru enough at the time she gave a false name.
- Good-natured. Can use magic. Was true to her ideals but not honest with herself.

Knows:
- Specialty is ice magic. Activated her magic with the faint sound of shattering air.
- Subaru ran into her the first and third time in a place not far from the main street.

Speech:
- She told Subaru a name that was not her real name.

---

**Character 6: Felt (the thief)**

Took the badge with a jewel from its owner. Appears in Subaru's flashbacks.

Knows:
- Felt had the badge stolen by Felt on all three iterations (the badge was taken by Felt).

Wants:
- Felt was the reason for Subaru's meeting with the three thugs hours before.

---

**Character 7: Elsa (Felt's associate, master of the loot cellar)**

Elsa had her negotiations with Felt. She made sure no one was left alive at the loot cellar. Her fight with the woman who saved Subaru is unavoidable on the fourth time around.

---

**Character 8: Beatrice (magic user, Subaru's ally)**

Good-natured. Can use magic. Wasn't honest with herself but was true to her ideals. Subaru believes she may be dead, but does not believe she could be dead. She told Subaru that if anything happened he was to call her.

---

**Character 9: Woman with long brown hair (encountered earlier)**

Had seen earlier by Emilia. Present when the two were earlier encountered.

---

**Character 10: Shop owner and shop owner's daughter**

The shop owner yelled and said, "Th-this wasn't a good idea after all, was it?" The shop owner's daughter was saved by the people in the group. The shop owner thanked the group. Subaru says the shop owner did not ask where the woman had gone, which struck a deep wound in his heart.

---

**Character 11: Little lost girl**

A young girl in a white robe with silver hair. Crying near the buildings across the street. Asked to hold hands. Her father and mother are lost. Her mother is found with Emilia's help. She waves goodbye with a bright, cheerful expression.

---

Other descriptions (character unclear from text):
- Speaks with an unreasonable manner early on, then becomes friendly and familiar toward Subaru.
- Looks refreshed and seems to believe what she says.
- Tells Subaru he will end up losing everything one day because of his personality.
- Calls Subaru a nice boy and treats him as younger.
- Wears fine clothes and a white cloak that make her stand out in the slums.
- Has a finger-to-lips thinking habit.
- Wears a red flower ornament on her left breast.
- Wants to be useful and says Subaru puts too much emphasis on himself.
- Stares at Subaru with a face showing regret over having raised her opinion of him earlier.
- Holds a green crystal and puts it back in her breast pocket.
- Takes a white crystal (lagmite ore) out of her breast pocket, which shines white.
- Stands guard outside while Subaru goes in, then waits for Subaru's call.
- Vanguard of the search party who walks ahead and tells Subaru to watch what is behind them.
- Often sighs in trouble and exasperation with Subaru, and jokingly points out that she can see up his nostrils.
- Mentioned only: someone whose safety Subaru is confirming. Subaru is trying to reunite with her and risks losing her if the situation goes wrong.

entities.name: Unnamed kid
entities.description: A kid on the other side of the main road, whom Satella fixed her gaze on. Satella wondered whether the kid is lost.

entities.name: young girl
entities.description: Looks around ten years old, with very cute shoulder-length brown hair. Would probably make people around her want to smile back if she smiled, but at the moment her eyes are filled with anxiety and she looks moments away from tears. Is crying.

entities.name: stolen item
entities.description:
Stolen items:

- An item stolen from Satella by the thief. If sold, it cannot be recovered.
- Many varied stolen goods, including small boxes, pots, swords, and cheap metal objects, crowd the counter. Each has a wooden tag marking it as stolen.
- Various stolen goods lie scattered in the loot cellar. They seem unorganized.
- An item stolen by Felt on Elsa's orders. Subaru planned to return it to its owner.
- An unnamed item Satella searched for in her robe. The Blond Thief took it and fled.
- Items lying in the loot cellar, frozen by Puck's attack.
- An item Felt stole from Emilia and later returned. Emilia considers it important and wants it hidden better.

entities.name: buildings across the street
entities.description: Buildings across the street, near where the young girl stands. Satella is looking toward them.

entities.name: street
entities.description:
Summary of the street descriptions:

- A busy street with buildings on one side and many people around. Satella is looking at it from across the street.
- Satella trotted across the street to a little girl.
- A city street where Subaru watched people pass by.
- A side street off the main road. It is gloomy, still, and silent, with no sign of life or people.
- A slum street with buildings on both sides. The sky between the buildings has turned orange.
- A crowded street where a canvas-topped cart lies on its side.
- A street where Subaru snapped his fingers so everyone could see him.
- A street where a blond-haired girl ran frantically when she asked Reinhard for help.

entities.name: little girl
entities.description:
Small girl, a lost child separated from her mother who later appears as the daughter of the stern-faced shop owner and the woman with long brown hair. She has teary eyes, looks down when crying, and shivers when she does not know what to do. Her eyes open wide with fear, not relief, when a stranger speaks to her. She is small, and she holds the notched ten-yen coin close.

Personality:
- Anxious and frightened when lost, with a glimmer of hope when she thinks someone is the person she is looking for.
- Calmed by Subaru's magic.
- Curious, looking very curiously at the ten-yen coin.
- Shy and easily flustered around Satella; blushes and looks away when Satella smiles at her.
- Lonely, as described by Subaru, and in need of another friend.
- Grateful, reaching out her hand to Satella holding a small red flower ornament to thank her in her own way.
- Affectionate and friendly toward her rescuers, looking very happy to see Subaru and Satella.

Wants:
- To find her mother.
- To be reunited with her parents.

Knows:
- The ten-yen coin is special and must be taken good care of, as Subaru told her.
- Subaru's right hand did not hold the coin; she was stunned when she saw the coin between the fingers of Subaru's left hand.
- She received the notched ten-yen coin from Subaru as a present.

Secret:
- None stated.

Speech:
- Answers Subaru's questions quickly and clearly.
- Often communicates by nodding: silently nods when reassured by Satella and nods vigorously after receiving the coin.
- Shakes her head back and forth when distressed.

entities.name: ten-yen coin
entities.description: Special coin used in Subaru's magic trick; given to the little girl as a present to keep and take good care of.

entities.name: mother
entities.description:
The little girl's mother: a woman who was separated from her daughter. Subaru says they will find her right away.

Personality:
- Urges others on and speaks with gentle insistence.

Wants:
- Her daughter to be found.
- Her daughter to be able to thank Satella in her own way.

Knows:
- (No specific facts given.)

Speech:
- Polite and warm. Says, "Please, take it. My daughter wants to thank you in her own way."

entities.name: girl's mother
entities.description: Mother of the little girl; was reunited with her child; thanked Subaru and Satella several times.

entities.name: nearest wall
entities.description: The wall nearest to Satella is where she knelt after turning away from Subaru. The nearest wall had slime wiped on it. Subaru hit his back against it after being blown away.

entities.name: Lugunica's capital city
entities.description: Capital of Lugunica and the largest city in the nation. About 300,000 people live there, and many others come and go. Described as a medieval fantasy-setting city that is very large, with complicated roads and alleyways. Home to a mix of half-humans, half-beasts, and regular humans, resembling a melting pot of races.

entities.name: little lost girl
entities.description:
A small girl who got lost and was saved by Not-Satella. Mentioned only in passing.

Knows:
- The town is too big to search around in (made clear by the episode with her).

entities.name: alleyways
entities.description:
Here is the summary:

- Complicated city alleys where Subaru and Satella got lost for almost an hour.
- Located right beside a stall, about four spaces left of the shop owner. Has a few holes gouged out of its wall leading into it.
- A dim slum alley where Felt and Subaru talk. Felt's crimson eyes glow in the dim light.

entities.name: street corner
entities.description: A crowded street corner is where Satella had her badge stolen. Subaru was also summoned to this same corner. The area is busy, with many different kinds of people and a lot of commotion on the street.

entities.name: maze of alleyways
entities.description: Area of alleyways through which Subaru and the group previously made their way, where Subaru lost his sense of distance and direction.

entities.name: crowd
entities.description:
A busy street crowd is full of different people. Satella's badge was stolen here, and the thief could easily get lost in it.

A group of people stood on the main street. They did not respond well to Subaru's call for help and were not swayed by his threats.

entities.name: empty alley
entities.description: An alley where Subaru went to cool his head after being so confused; he had an encounter with thugs A, B, and C there.

entities.name: thugs A, B, and C
entities.description: Thugs who had an encounter with Subaru in an empty alley about two hours before the events described.

entities.name: fruit shop
entities.description:
A fruit shop stands on the side of the main road. Its fresh fruit makes one's mouth water. The stern-faced owner works behind the counter and is often in a bad mood.

Subaru and Satella reunited with a little girl and her mother here. They gained valuable information at the shop. Subaru once sat glumly in front of it for an uncertain length of time.

On his first visit, Subaru and Not-Satella met the shop owner's daughter.

entities.name: shop owner
entities.description:
Owner of a fruit shop, also called Mr. Fruit Salesman and Pops by Subaru. Muscular, with a bandanna, a stern face, a deep threatening voice, and a white scar running down the left side of his face, probably left by some kind of blade.

Personality:
- Stern and threatening, gives a cold glare.
- Does not seem like a respectable, law-abiding citizen.
- Was unsure how to react to Subaru's behavior.
- Put on his best smile with a strong nod when pleased.
- Wears a smile that probably scares customers away.
- Seems to be reaching his limit, with his face starting to twitch, after a long dealing with Subaru.
- In a bad mood.
- Kind enough not to ask where Satella had gone.
- Monotone in speech.

Wants:
- Thought Subaru was a customer at first and acted nicely to him, but since Subaru has no money he is chasing him out.
- Wants Subaru to buy an apple, saying that if he does, he'll be a customer and will be welcomed.
- Had no time to deal with the two paupers in his shop.

Knows:
- Subaru's penniless state, and that Subaru was unable to buy anything.
- Says commotions are not unusual around here.
- The most recent commotion was not the usual fare: someone was using magic and shot off two or three blasts.
- Leaned forward and pointed to a stall about four spaces to the left, beside an alleyway with holes gouged in the wall.
- Icicle-shaped things were used like arrows, and one stuck inside the wall and disappeared immediately afterward.
- Has a daughter who was not yet saved this time around.
- Said that just a little while ago, another penniless person like Subaru helped his little girl out.
- The little girl's father watched everything and cleared his throat.

Secret:
- Does not seem like a respectable, law-abiding citizen.

Speech:
- Deep and threatening voice.
- Calls Subaru 'Mr. Broke' and 'Mr. Penniless'.
- Says "Take a hint!" and "Then get the hell out of here!"
- Asks Subaru if he is buying anything, saying he has guts asking a question without buying anything.
- Sighed and asked what the two paupers wanted to say, now that "one beggar's become two".
- Said, "You saved my daughter. I want to thank you. Ask me whatever you want."
- Waves his hand to shoo Subaru away like a bug.
- Waved back at Subaru when Subaru did radio exercises in front of his store.
- Speaks in a monotone.

entities.name: Shop
entities.description:
Several shops appear in the story. One shop belongs to a shop owner. Subaru and Satella went there to ask for help but had no money to buy anything. Subaru was later thrown out of a shop run by the shop owner after failing to buy an apple.

A shop belongs to a scar-faced man, and a woman visits it. Subaru and Satella look inside. The scar-faced man sells apples here. It also has another part where he goes to work.

Subaru looked around a shop. The man went across to another part of it. In another shop, Subaru spoke with the man and asked for his opinion.

entities.name: woman with long brown hair
entities.description: Has long brown hair. Subaru and Satella had seen her before. Asked 'Hmm? Are you…the two from before?' upon seeing them. Was not alone; was holding the hand of a little girl.

entities.name: scar-faced man
entities.description: Shop owner and husband of the woman; described as heartless, scary-faced, and stern-faced. Has folded his arms. Is the father of the little girl. Calls Subaru and Satella 'destitute beggars'. Speaks sharply, then sets his daughter down after hearing what happened and apologizes: 'I'm sorry about that. That was not the way to talk to the people who saved my daughter. Please forgive me.' Scolded by his wife for calling them beggars. Is called 'Pops' by Subaru.

entities.name: red flower ornament
entities.description: A small ornament in the shape of a red flower. The little girl gave it to Satella, who pinned it on the left breast of her white cloak.

entities.name: Street Near the Main Road
entities.description: The street Subaru and Satella were on. It was not far from the main road, and the hustle and bustle from before now seemed like a far-off dream. It supposedly leads to the slums.

entities.name: Slums Entrance
entities.description: The entrance to the rumored slums, where Subaru and Satella were standing about thirty minutes after reuniting with the little girl and her mother at the fruit shop. They were hesitating here.

entities.name: Slums
entities.description:
- The slums are rumored to receive most stolen goods, which are handled and sold there. Subaru assumes the people and mood are terrible.
- The area is dark, dreary, damp, and smells sour. Sky shows between the buildings.
- This is the next stage of the task. It is troublesome, and residents often fight.
- People here struggle. Subaru seems more likable here, and Satella's fine clothes make her stand out.
- Subaru and Satella began asking questions here. The search took just under an hour to find useful information.
- This is the deepest part of the city, far from the castle. The loot cellar sits here against the tall defensive wall.
- Residents never easily agree to anything.
- Subaru plans to go here after leaving the alley. He knows this place.
- This is Subaru's destination. It lies in a different direction from the loot cellar.
- Subaru visited twice. The residents pitied him and cooperated the first time, but were cold the second time.
- This dark area has puddles of unknown liquid. Subaru and Elsa meet in an alley deep inside.
- This deepest part has a dark alley full of rotten garbage.
- The area is linked to the slogan "live strong," which Subaru compares to the slums' slogan.
- This drear area has narrow gaps between buildings and alleys where little sunlight reaches. It is damp, with broken bottles, scrap paper, and a strong stench.
- These outskirts are where losers live. Felt hates this place and wants to leave. People here have given up and seem content. Some alleys are dim.
- Felt resents the people here, but someone Felt cares about lives here.
- This area has an entrance. The loot cellar is reached after passing it.
- Felt would have hired people here to delay Not-Satella.
- Reinhard went here to investigate.

entities.name: Stern-faced shop owner
entities.description: Owner of the fruit shop and father of the little girl. Has a stern face. After realizing Subaru and Satella had helped his daughter, he warmed up to them and listened to their plight. Told them that the badge would probably be in the slums and added that they should probably give up.

entities.name: Little girl's mother
entities.description: Mother of the little girl. Reunited unexpectedly with Subaru and Satella at the fruit shop.

entities.name: That guy
entities.description: Unnamed informant who told Subaru and Satella that if they were looking for stolen goods, they would be handled and sold in the slums.

entities.name: Satella's badge
entities.description: Satella's badge is what Subaru and Satella are looking for. It may be in the slums. Subaru was looking for it in the cellar. Felt stole it in all three previous iterations. Subaru believes it cannot fetch a higher price in this world than his cell phone.

entities.name: Stolen goods
entities.description: Stolen goods are said to be handled and sold in the slums. Felt stole items, which are probably in the loot cellar. They are tagged and will be sold at a market elsewhere. Subaru and Satella would need to negotiate a price to buy them back.

entities.name: Police and guards
entities.description: Authority figures Subaru suggested asking for help to search for the badge. Satella rejected asking them.

entities.name: guards
entities.description:
Satella doubts the guards would act over such a small theft. She also cannot ask them for help because of her other reasons.

If given the wooden tags, they could arrest everyone at once, as Subaru remarked about how the system works.

The guards are an organization that works like a police force. Dumb, Dumber, and Dumbest said the word "guards" while afraid, and Subaru calls for them to help.

Subaru called for the guards when thugs were involved. He thought a guard would be lowly and rough, but Reinhard does not match that.

Guards could be called to the loot cellar to help catch Felt. Subaru thinks they would be ineffective against Elsa unless all of them were superhuman.

Not-Satella did not want them involved. Felt says that if Subaru had wanted to round them up, he should have brought a guard with him.

entities.name: Slum residents
entities.description: The people living in the slums. Probably used to getting into fights. For some unknown reason, they are really nice to Subaru.

entities.name: Unnamed Speaker
entities.description:
Unnamed character; the owner of a familiar voice who offers Subaru abbles. Not named in the text.

Personality:
- Gruff and dismissive
- Casual in manner
- Tells the young lady she does not belong in this place with her fancy clothes and orders her to go away

Knows:
- Subaru has grown familiar with this voice and has grown used to hearing its question

Speech:
- Gruff, dismissive, and casual
- Says: 'Hey, man, don't just stare off into space like that. You want an abble?'
- Says: 'So, kiddo. How's about that abble?'
- Offers Subaru a ripe red abble as soon as Subaru's consciousness returns

entities.name: red flower decoration
entities.description: A red flower decoration is pinned on Satella's left breast. Satella finds comfort in it. A red flower decoration is also pinned to the left breast of Not-Satella's cloak.

entities.name: cloak
entities.description: Cloak worn by Satella, whose shoulders she grips with both hands and refuses to take off.

entities.name: criminal
entities.description: A criminal that Satella and Subaru are chasing and searching for; Subaru says they will soon have her cornered.

entities.name: green crystal
entities.description: Crystal glowing with a green light, taken from Satella's breast pocket. Glows with a faint light in Satella's hand. Does not look like a jewel; 'crystal' is the word that fits best. Puck hugs it to his small body.

entities.name: crystal
entities.description: A crystal that Satella carries in her breast pocket. Subaru believes it is holding Puck's core. Satella runs her hands lightly over it and carefully puts it back in her breast pocket.

entities.name: Felt girl
entities.description: Blond and really fast. Mentioned by Subaru as a possible candidate for the person they are searching for.

entities.name: informant
entities.description: Unnamed person in the slums who gave the group valuable information after being approached by Subaru, who greeted them as if they were already friends.

entities.name: the man who gave the information
entities.description: Unnamed man who told Subaru where Felt's stolen goods probably are and where the loot cellar is. Explained that the cellar master sells goods at a market elsewhere. Said the cellar master's reputation comes from people trusting him not to steal goods. Warned that the cellar master would likely reply 'So what?' if told the goods are stolen, so one should be prepared to negotiate a price to buy them back. Said that the original owner is at fault for getting the item stolen. Laughs when speaking.

entities.name: loot cellar
entities.description:
- Felt takes stolen goods here to be tagged. An old man sells them at a market elsewhere.
- Called the loot cellar. It is much bigger than Subaru expected and may hold only stolen goods.
- Holds items until they are sold, so it is rarely full. It is wide, not tall, and stands against a tall wall in the deepest slums.
- A pitch-black cellar of stolen goods with a sour, spoiled smell. Its door has a gap and is unlocked.
- Subaru found a corpse here.
- Subaru's last location before he lost consciousness. He wants to return to look for clues.
- Located in the deepest slums. Its name cannot be spoken outside the slums. Subaru needed nearly two hours to find it.
- A cellar holding the answers Subaru seeks. A rough door with a password lock opens only from inside.
- Subaru was admitted here after a violent first meeting. It has a counter facing the door and a fixed visitor chair.
- Stolen items are strewn about. Subaru saw a tragedy here the previous evening, but no trace remains. The counter is inside.
- A dark place where Subaru saw a corpse, later identified as Old Man Rom.
- Rom works in this black market area, which trades stolen junk and rare items.
- A dark room where a meeting takes place.
- A room where a fight occurred. Felt screamed here. Rom's blood covered the room, and his severed right arm hit the wall.
- A cellar with a floor of blood and a giant corpse missing an arm. A reddish blade glints nearby. Elsa vanished in its shadows.
- Subaru went here after an incident and could not meet Satella.
- Subaru considers going here to look for Rom and others, or as a possible destination.
- Subaru showed his crispy snacks to Rom here.
- Subaru's first death site, visited with Satella. Felt and Elsa negotiated here, and Rom's giant corpse lies here.
- The only place Subaru can meet Elsa. He must go here to take back Satella's badge.
- A place in this world that Subaru knows.
- An old man Subaru knows hangs out here. Guards could be sent here.
- Filled with items stolen from across the capital.
- Subaru has been killed here twice and wants to avoid it. Felt is expected to enter, and the theft likely happens here.
- Lies in a different direction from the slums route. Going there raises bad flags.
- Felt may go here before returning home.
- Elsa likely went here after wandering the area, or before meeting Subaru.
- Deep in the slums. A weird old man here gives fair, experienced appraisals.
- The destination of Subaru and Felt. The deal with Rom will be settled here quickly.
- The destination of the trip through the slums. Subaru has come here three times in this loop.
- Subaru wants Felt to take him here at once, since her route is wrong. Felt leads him here directly on his fourth visit.
- A dusty cellar entered through a door that slams open. Felt enters it as if it were her own. Rom shrank his giant body back into it.
- Subaru names it as a sign of danger.
- A dim confrontation site in the slums. Its door opens from outside. Sunset light flooded in when the door opened.
- Not-Satella reached it in a short time, which is normally impossible.
- Filled with white light and frozen by Puck's attack. Has a counter and stolen items. Its door was blown off its hinges.
- A room where flames burned through the roof from the center.
- The destination of Felt's flight through the entryway.
- A cellar where an old two-handed sword leans against the wall. Reinhard looked inside during an exchange.
- A mostly ruined battle room. A brilliant light blew off its roof and split the space in two.
- A loot cellar nearly destroyed, with only a few pillars left. The blond-haired girl hides at its entrance.
- A place in the slums with an open area in front.
- Destroyed by Reinhard's power miscalculation. The area is off limits for a while.

entities.name: old man master of the cellar
entities.description: The master of the loot cellar. Old man who has the goods sold at a market somewhere else. People trust him not to steal the goods. If told the goods are stolen, he would probably say 'So what?'. Expected to be a tough negotiator who could 'wipe the floor' with Subaru and Satella without leverage.

entities.name: market somewhere else
entities.description: Unspecified market where the loot cellar master sells the goods.

entities.name: negotiation
entities.description:
Subaru plans to buy back the stolen goods from the loot cellar master through negotiation. This would resolve the matter peacefully and with certainty.

Subaru negotiates with Felt, offering the metia in exchange for her badge. He plays his best card right away to gain the advantage.

Subaru and Felt talk about returning an item to its rightful owner for money. The talks fail because Felt does not change her mind.

entities.name: jewel
entities.description: Embedded in the center of the badge. Probably expensive; a jewel is an item that can be recognized as expensive at a glance, and most jewel-like things in this world are probably real jewels that would fetch a high price.

entities.name: tall defensive wall
entities.description: Tall defensive wall behind the loot cellar; believed to be one of the walls of the city.

entities.name: city
entities.description: Believed to be built as a square with walls on all four sides. A castle is likely located either in the center or on the northernmost side, with the slums positioned far away from it. The scope of the city seemed larger than Subaru originally imagined.

entities.name: castle
entities.description: Believed to be located either in the center or on the northernmost side of the city; the slums are positioned far away from it.

entities.name: master of the cellar
entities.description: Said to be in charge of the loot cellar and to handle all of the stolen goods. Details beyond this are not stated in the text.

entities.name: cellar entrance
entities.description: The entrance to the loot cellar has a door. The door is open and unlocked. A sour, spoiled smell drifts out. In the orange light of early evening, the rough door seems to reject Subaru. Subaru pounds on it, and the door creaks and its hinges begin to bend. Then it suddenly swings open with great force.

entities.name: Deepest Part of the Slums
entities.description:
A dark place where no moonlight reaches. It has no light, and one cannot see an inch in front of one's face. Its purpose is considered dirty business. It serves as a metaphor for the dark feeling of guilt.

It is an area of the slums. Subaru headed here after taking revenge in the alley. The loot cellar is located here.

entities.name: lagmite ore
entities.description: A white crystal taken from Satella's breast pocket that suddenly shines with a white light. Gives off a faint warmth along with its light, about as much illumination as a candle. Satella hands it to Subaru as a light source. Can be found just about anywhere, according to Satella.

entities.name: cellar
entities.description:
Here is the summary:

1. Subaru enters a cellar carefully, holding lagmite. He needed courage to go in.
2. A cellar where most stolen valuables seem to be kept, toward the back.
3. A cellar with a back area, where Rom fetched a large club.
4. The place for negotiation and bidding. A flash from Subaru's cell phone lit its inside.
5. A small enclosed space where Rom and Elsa fight. With little room to move, being cornered by the club could be fatal.
6. A location where Subaru, Felt, and Elsa are. Felt moves so fast it seems a gale passed through, and Felt runs across its walls as if they were ground.
7. A space that warped right after Reinhard's reply. It has ice magic, falling temperature, less light, and a changed atmosphere.
8. A room with an entrance. A counter stood next to the entrance until Reinhard's attack blew it away.

entities.name: lagmite
entities.description: Subaru held a light source as he carefully made his way into the cellar. Its light had a small visible range. When Subaru was blown against the wall, he let go of it on impact, and it tumbled into the distance.

entities.name: Building
entities.description:
A former inn, with a first-floor bar area kept mostly unchanged and a cellar. Stale air inside affects smells.

Satella entered this building and was cut down by the same weapon that took out Subaru.

Reinhard's kick shook the entire building with wind. Its supports were wrecked by the gusts, and it seemed ready to collapse at any moment.

The building is partially destroyed. Scraps have been thrown up, with a black shadow underneath.

entities.name: counter
entities.description:
A counter stands across from the entrance, in front of Subaru. It likely serves as a reception desk. Items are cluttered on and behind it.

A counter in the loot cellar faces the front door. Subaru sits in front of it and rests his elbow on it. Rom bends down behind it to get a bottle of liquor and places a glass on it. Subaru slams his glass on it after drinking.

In the dark building, Rom falls back behind a counter when a cell phone flashes. Later, he puts the phone back on a surface.

A counter sits near a small table. Relatively clean glasses are kept behind another counter, where Subaru went to get glasses.

Puck's attack froze a counter. Reinhard's attack blew away a counter next to the cellar entrance, along with its chairs.

entities.name: wooden tags
entities.description: Attached to all of the stolen items, indicating they are stolen. If rounded up and handed to the guards, they could arrest everyone at once, according to Subaru's remark on how the system works.

entities.name: sticky fluid
entities.description: Strangely sticky fluid found on the bottom of Subaru's sneakers; clings to fingers and stretches when pulled away; makes one feel uneasy. Smell could not be identified due to stagnant air.

entities.name: corpse of a large old man
entities.description: A corpse of a large old man, with all body parts except one arm, though the throat area is cut wide open. Its arm was found severed at the elbow, lying limp on the ground with its fingers reaching out as if to grab something. Its body was found farther along the axis of the severed arm.

entities.name: unnamed woman
entities.description: A woman whose voice is low and cold, and who seems somewhat to be having fun. She said: 'Well, you found it. That's just too bad. Now I have no choice, yes, no choice at all.' She is the apparent source of the incredible force that blew Subaru away and the heat that overwhelmed him. Subaru did not see her.

entities.name: red carpet of fresh blood
entities.description: Pool of fresh blood on the ground, rippled by a black boot stepping into it.

entities.name: black boot
entities.description: Black boot that steps down into the blood pool in front of Subaru Natsuki, belonging to the unseen person who was probably the killer.

entities.name: unseen killer
entities.description: Someone standing nearby, probably the one who killed Subaru Natsuki. Subaru did not look at their face. Only their black boot is seen.

entities.name: she
entities.description: An unnamed person Subaru Natsuki wishes to be safe. Only referred to as 'she'.

entities.name: heat
entities.description: An overwhelming heat that assaults Subaru Natsuki and burns through his body, caused by his brain mistaking pain for heat; disappears as his consciousness fades.

entities.name: large cut in stomach
entities.description: A clean, deep cut running through Subaru Natsuki's torso, almost cutting him in half; the source of his waning life.

entities.name: Scar-faced Shopkeeper
entities.description: A muscular man with a white scar across his stern face. Offers Subaru a round, cute-looking red fruit called an abble (it looks almost exactly like an apple) and asks whether he will buy it. Annoyed with Subaru for wasting his time, tells him to get out, says he has a job to do and no time for nonsense. Pushes Subaru aside and moves to another part of the shop.

entities.name: abble
entities.description: Apple-like red fruit, round and cute-looking, offered by the scar-faced shop owner. Subaru cannot afford it. It is also called "abble" in the text. Subaru promised to buy apples from the shop owner next time.

entities.name: the man
entities.description: Annoyed. Pushed Subaru aside and went across to another part of the shop.

entities.name: lizard carts
entities.description: Carts pulled by lizards pass along the main road. They sometimes move among pedestrians.

entities.name: wolflike half-humans
entities.description: Walk around the main road in fur coats. Wolflike half-humans who seem as though they would be sweating in the heat.

entities.name: tracksuit
entities.description: Subaru's tracksuit is beloved. It has no damage, despite an earlier wound. It has a top with a hem. Subaru lifted the top to check his stomach.

entities.name: corpse
entities.description: A dead man found by Subaru in the loot cellar. The person who probably killed him attacked Subaru.

entities.name: weapon
entities.description: Unnamed weapon that cut open Subaru's stomach and cut down Satella.

entities.name: aloof weirdo spirit cat
entities.description: A spirit cat described as aloof and a weirdo. Subaru does not believe it could be dead and does not want it to be dead.

entities.name: three thugs
entities.description:
Three thugs who block a back alley and corner Subaru, the same three men who were the reason he and Satella first met hours earlier. Rough, barbaric, and dirty, with identical faces.

Personality:
- Classic thugs with bad personalities and bad upbringings
- Sinister smiles; they mock Subaru
- Taunting; they consider themselves the winners of the last encounter
- Rough and barbaric in appearance, with dirty clothes
- Use these alleys as their hunting grounds

Wants:
- To catch Subaru
- To have some fun with him
- Determined to catch Subaru after failing twice before

Knows:
- They have attacked Subaru three times that day, always three against one in a back alley
- Their first and second efforts failed, and they lost the last encounter, which they consider three-on-one
- Subaru does not realize the mess he has gotten himself into
- Subaru's attitude is wrong and he is not in a position to order them around

Secret:
- Subaru does not realize the mess he has gotten himself into, and they are willing to tell him

Speech:
- "Hey, kiddo. How about let's have some fun."
- "I bet he doesn't realize the mess he's gotten himself into. How 'bout we tell 'im?"
- Taunts that even sore losers would show more shame when they wail

entities.name: skinny mob man with knife
entities.description: One of three mob characters with the exact same face. The skinniest of the group and the one who had the knife, which was the source of Subaru's defeat before. Told: 'You're first! Guys like you who don't know the preciousness of life can go to hell!' (said by Subaru). Was hit first by Subaru with an uppercut to the jaw and a punch to the open abdomen, slammed against the wall, and knocked out like a light.

entities.name: second mob man
entities.description: One of three mob characters with the exact same face. Stood beside the skinny man and was not prepared for Subaru's sudden change of attitude. Was shaking while standing dumbfounded. Was unable to react, was kicked by Subaru, and fell over.

entities.name: third mob man
entities.description: One of three mob characters with the exact same face. Was not prepared for Subaru's sudden change of attitude and was shaking while standing dumbfounded. Was tackled low by Subaru and slammed into the wall.

entities.name: wall
entities.description:
Walls:

1. The wall where the skinny mob man and the third mob man were slammed.
2. A wall Subaru steps back against, then slides down to the floor.
3. A wall at the alley's dead end, too high for Subaru to climb but possibly easy for Felt.
4. A wall Subaru leans against after Elsa leaves.
5. Elsa sprang off walls to reduce the damage from Reinhard's kick.
6. A wall where Reinhard's thrown kukri lodged, and where Rom was dragged along.
7. A wall Subaru struck after being thrown.
8. A wall where Subaru collapsed upside down, and Not-Satella raced over to it.

entities.name: Knife-wielding man
entities.description: Thug who carried a knife. Had comparatively taken little damage but was sweating. Tried to pull out his knife as Subaru approached, and was kicked relentlessly in the face and knocked out.

entities.name: the men in the alley
entities.description: Men who were in the alley where Subaru enacted his revenge. None of them had actually died; Subaru checked for sure.

entities.name: onlookers
entities.description: Onlookers in the alley area who were wowing and gasping in surprise that Subaru left the alley unscathed. They realized Subaru was back there but did not go to the guards.

entities.name: signs
entities.description: Signs in the slums that Subaru cannot read.

entities.name: old man's corpse
entities.description: The corpse of an old man, seen in Subaru's flashback. Not present in the scene.

entities.name: giant, red-faced, bald old man
entities.description: A giant, red-faced, bald old man who opens the door of the loot cellar with great force, throwing Subaru back. Speaks harshly: 'Cut it out already! What are you doing, trying to break the door down just because you don't know the password?!' Subaru's gaze ends on him after he is thrown.

entities.name: password
entities.description: A password required to get through the loot cellar door, as mentioned by the giant, red-faced, bald old man.

entities.name: Natsuki Subaru
entities.description: Introduces himself as 'Natsuki Subaru, the ever-busy and never-free wandering vagrant.' Normally believes he can win in a fight, but these circumstances were not ordinary and he lost all desire to resist when held up by the giant old man. Asked the old man, 'For now at least, would you be so kind as to put me down? Let's talk with both our feet on the ground,' giving it his all to squeeze out that indirect request. Had first gotten information about the loot cellar from an informant (a man who introduced him to the place) and described that man to the giant old man. Sat on a fixed chair meant for visitors in front of the counter and shifted uncomfortably because of splinters poking him in the rear. Claims his 'boys are just fine' when the old man asks if he is concerned about where his balls are, and asks whether that is really the first thing the old man says in this situation.

entities.name: Giant Old Man
entities.description: A giant, very energetic-looking old geezer, six- or seven-foot-tall, with a muscular body covered by ragged clothes and a polished bald head that the red light of the setting sun shone on. Moves with astonishing speed. Demands to know: 'Who are you, boy?! I've not seen you around here before! How did you know where to find this place? How did you get here? Who told you?!' Lifted Subaru up by the collar. Asks 'Why do you keep moving about like that? Are you that concerned about where your balls are?' Name not given in the text.

entities.name: Unnamed Informant
entities.description: The man from whom Subaru first got information about the loot cellar. Introduced Subaru to the place. Subaru described him to the giant old man. Name not given in the text.

entities.name: Front Door
entities.description: The front door of the loot cellar, which the counter faces.

entities.name: Fixed Chair
entities.description: A fixed chair meant for visitors, in front of the counter. Has splinters sticking up out of the seat that poke the sitter in the rear.

entities.name: bottle of liquor
entities.description: Bottle of liquor that Rom brings up from behind the counter and pours from into a glass.

entities.name: dirty glass
entities.description: Dirty glass Rom pours liquor into and drinks from.

entities.name: tragedy
entities.description: Tragedy Subaru witnessed the previous evening in the loot cellar, which includes a decapitated arm and a sliced throat. No trace of it remains in the loot cellar.

entities.name: Old Man Rom
entities.description:
Old Man Rom, called 'Old Man Rom'. An old man with gray eyes and a corpse-like appearance, with many characteristic features that Subaru recognizes from the corpse he saw in the loot cellar. He is a giant-bodied fighter who wields a club with a spiked part that he has held since the negotiations began. The club weighs at least twenty pounds, yet he swings it as if it were a twig, fast enough that untrained blocks would be no more effective than a sheet of paper.

Personality:
- Opened his gray eyes wide for a few moments, then broke into a laugh: "Ga-ha-ha-ha!"
- Says he may be an old man with not much time left to live, but he hasn't died yet, and doesn't imagine death being that far off at his age.
- Apparently took Subaru's question as some kind of edgy joke.
- Has started to look like the grandfather who spoils his granddaughter like she was a cute kitten.
- Looks thrilled as he pours another glass of milk for Felt.
- Most people forget about using violence as an option because he is around; the thought of having to fight this scary old man sends shivers down one's spine.
- Does not seem too bothered that others have this opinion of him.
- Roars "Rrrragh!" while attacking Elsa and insults her, threatening to turn her into mincemeat and feed her to the giant rats.
- Kicked over a small wooden table during the fight, then swung his club down with all his might toward Elsa, which would have been an instant kill if it had landed.
- Despite having his right arm severed at the shoulder by Elsa's attack, and spraying blood from the shoulder like a hose, he leapt toward Elsa to attack her with his one remaining arm.

Wants:
- Wants Felt to keep coming back to him; he worries about her.
- Wants to spoil Felt with milk and sweets.
- Wants to take Elsa down with him: "If I'm going down, I'm taking you with me!"

Knows:
- Has never lost a fight, according to Felt.
- Fights Elsa in the cellar, where his swings are dangerous in the cramped space.

Speech:
- "Ga-ha-ha-ha! I was wondering what you were going to say!"
- "Want a drink?"
- "You really can't do anything without me, can you, Felt? I worry about you. Would you like another glass of milk? I also have some other things that are a little sweeter."
- "Rrrragh!"
- "If I'm going down, I'm taking you with me!"

entities.name: glass
entities.description:
Rom took out a glass for Subaru and offered him an alcoholic drink. Subaru refused.

Later, Rom filled a glass with amber-colored liquid and placed it in front of Subaru. Subaru drank the liquor in one gulp and slammed the glass on the counter.

entities.name: amber-colored liquid
entities.description: Strong-smelling alcohol, poured by Rom into a glass; burns the esophagus when drunk in one gulp.

entities.name: badge with embedded jewel
entities.description: A badge that has a jewel embedded in it. Subaru is looking for it and wants Rom to let him have it. It is so important to Satella that she would face danger to get it back. Retrieving it would give Subaru a clue toward finding Satella.

entities.name: stolen articles of value
entities.description: Stolen valuables that appear to be concentrated in the back of the cellar.

entities.name: liquor
entities.description: Strong drink that burned Subaru's esophagus when he drank it in one gulp. Subaru says it tastes terrible, while Rom says it tastes good.

entities.name: bottle
entities.description: The bottle of liquor Rom took up and gulped from.

entities.name: badge with a jewel
entities.description: Item Subaru is looking for; believed to have been taken by a thief named Felt. Has a jewel embedded in it, so it would fetch a high price. Believed to be Satella's badge.

entities.name: frozen image of Rom's face
entities.description: A captured image of Rom's face, cut out of time just before the flash and stored within the cell phone. Rom sees it and recognizes it as his face.

entities.name: building interior
entities.description: A dark interior of a building containing a counter. The flash of the cell phone lights it briefly with white light.

entities.name: metia
entities.description:
Metia are magic items that let users work magic without opening a gate. They are mostly given as gifts rather than used as tools. Subaru's metia is also called a cell phone. It cuts out a slice of time and stores it as a copy of a person.

Subaru plans to trade his metia for Felt's badge. Felt cares only about how much money it can sell for. She says it could easily fetch twenty blessed gold coins, even in the worst case. Rom saw that Subaru has it and asked whether the badge is worth more.

The item is rare and probably the only one in the world. A muscular man says it should sell for over twenty blessed gold coins. Rom says it should sell for at least twenty gold coins in the worst case. It is shown on screen.

Felt says the deal lets her turn this metia into cash. She believes the badge is worth more than it.

entities.name: corn chips
entities.description: Snack food belonging to Subaru, described by Rom as delicious. Subaru's last food on him; eaten by Rom.

entities.name: door
entities.description: A locked door. Rom unlocks it after a special knock and correct password answers. Rom wants curt answers to short questions. Felt slips past Rom through the door. It is the entrance door. Felt reached to open it, but Subaru warned him not to.

entities.name: knock at the door
entities.description: A special knock on the door, along with the password answers, that Rom accepts as passwords.

entities.name: password negotiations
entities.description: A round of negotiations that Subaru got through before chatting with Rom.

entities.name: glass of milk
entities.description:
Subaru offers Felt a glass of milk to help her relax after she sits down.

Rom pours two glasses of milk and sets them in front of Felt and Subaru. Felt says it tastes terrible.

Felt drinks the only cold glass of milk left and refuses to share it.

entities.name: jeweled badge
entities.description: A jeweled badge hidden away in Felt's pocket; the item Felt stole and the object Subaru's business is with.

entities.name: small table
entities.description: A small table near the counter where Felt and Subaru sat down on either side, and where Subaru pointed.

entities.name: dragon badge
entities.description: A badge about the size that would fit easily in the palm of your hand. Has a design in the shape of a winged dragon, intricate, with a red jewel in the dragon's open mouth that sparkles and makes it look very unique. Material cannot be identified by Subaru. Slid to the edge of the table by Felt.

entities.name: table
entities.description: A table holds Felt's badge, which is slid to its edge, and Subaru's cell phone, which he slaps down. Felt and Elsa sit at this table, and Subaru sets down glasses of milk here.

entities.name: Felt's image
entities.description: Photo copy of Felt displayed on the cell phone screen, captured by the metia's continuous shooting.

entities.name: photo shoot
entities.description: Subaru took several rapid shots of Felt with the cell phone; a white light flashed and a mechanical-like shutter sound went off several times at a rapid pace.

entities.name: trade
entities.description: Subaru and Felt agree to trade the metia for the badge. Rom approves the exchange. Felt interrupts Subaru before he takes the badge to sweeten the deal. Subaru proposes trading the card for Felt's badge. Felt accepts the card, and the negotiation ends.

entities.name: ten blessed gold coins
entities.description: Summary: These descriptions all refer to a currency or payment in a deal. The payment is a sum of twenty blessed gold coins, which are rarer than regular gold and worth more. Twenty of these coins is the price offered for the cell phone and for Felt's badge. Elsa first offered ten of them for the badge. Subaru's prepared item is worth more than twenty. A rival has also offered the same amount. Felt says the deal was for twenty coins, but Subaru only said he brought something worth that much. Felt asks if the deal will make her dream come true. She no longer doubts the card is worth this amount. El can only pay this sum.

entities.name: gold coins
entities.description: Currency mentioned as the standard unit of value. Subaru does not understand how much ten gold coins are worth.

entities.name: person who asked Felt to steal the badge
entities.description: Asked Felt to steal the badge in exchange for ten blessed gold coins. Is paying Felt four times the badge's worth. Name not given in the text.

entities.name: commissioner
entities.description: The person who commissioned Felt to steal the badge. Has a prior agreement with Felt and may offer more than twenty blessed golden coins for the badge. Felt will meet them to negotiate. Name not given in the text.

entities.name: Unnamed visitor
entities.description: The other person Felt agreed to meet after sunset. Likely the one who delivered the sharp knock on the door, as Felt believed it was probably for her. Was not told about the special knock. Name not given in the text.

entities.name: club
entities.description:
Spiked club, about the length of a bamboo kendo sword, made of wood. Sharp points stick out in various places, so a clean hit would easily be fatal.

Weighs at least twenty pounds. Rom swings it with all his might and never lets go of it. It slams against the cellar floor and makes the building shake. A swing brings a gust of air.

Rom swung it at Elsa, aiming for an instant kill. His right arm still gripped it when the arm was severed.

Subaru swung it at the back of Elsa's head. Elsa's blade struck it and changed its course, so it missed. Subaru then readjusted his grip. He swung it with all his might at Elsa. He tried to raise it to block Elsa's kukri swing, and later used it to guard his stomach against her strike.

entities.name: sharp knock
entities.description: A sharp knock on the door that came just after the conversation about the other person coming. All three people at the table looked at one another after it.

entities.name: slum area
entities.description: A surrounding slum area where everyone is just struggling to survive and where Rom and Felt have been living.

entities.name: incredibly beautiful woman
entities.description: Unnamed woman invited into the room by Felt, who sits behind Felt when Felt returns. Subaru is surprised by her beauty. She is the next person Subaru is going to have to negotiate with.

entities.name: Beautiful Woman
entities.description: Unnamed, bewitchingly beautiful older woman invited in by Felt. Very tall for a woman, about the same height as Subaru, appears to be in her early twenties. Has eyes that angle down toward their edges and a certain calmness about her. Almost sickly white skin, visible in the darkness of the loot cellar. Wears a black coat, open at the front, with black clothes underneath tightly fitted against her skin. Fairly thin but has curves where they should be and a very nice body overall. Has black hair, which seems very rare in this world. Hair is tied in a braid reaching to her hips, the tip of which she twirls around her fingers. Seemed puzzled, not upset, by the many people awaiting her arrival. Said: "I get the feeling that there are a lot of unrelated people here."

entities.name: chair
entities.description: Seat given up by Subaru and taken by Felt. Felt sits in it.

entities.name: drinks
entities.description: Requested by Felt to be fetched by Subaru.

entities.name: old man
entities.description:
Persona sheet: An unnamed old man (multiple descriptions, possibly the same character)

Personality:
- Mutters nonsense to himself until addressed; says he doesn't know what Subaru is talking about and doesn't care.
- Likes to hang out at the loot cellar (as an old man Subaru knows).

Wants:
- Not stated in the text.

Knows:
- Elsa mentions that she understands his being there.
- Had met Subaru and Felt just under an hour before the attack, and talked and bared emotions with them.
- Not-Satella claims he is in league with the one who stole Subaru's badge.
- Emilia mentions him alongside the girl, involved in "what they were doing," which Reinhard does not think he can just ignore.

Secret:
- Not-Satella claims he is in league with the one who stole Subaru's badge.

Speech:
- Mutters nonsense to himself; when asked his opinion by Subaru, says he doesn't know what Subaru is talking about and doesn't care.

entities.name: relatively clean glasses
entities.description: Glasses picked out from behind the counter and filled with milk to serve the drinks.

entities.name: milk
entities.description: Milk poured into glasses and served to Felt and Elsa. Some was left on Elsa's lips.

entities.name: small leather bag
entities.description: Taken from Elsa's pocket and placed on the table. Contains heavy metal objects (blessed gold coins) that clang together; holds the payment prepared for the badge and extra funds.

entities.name: muscular man
entities.description: Mentioned by Subaru as the source of the estimate that the metia should sell for over twenty blessed gold coins.

entities.name: employer
entities.description: Elsa's employer, who wants the badge and gave Elsa a little extra money in case the other party had second thoughts about the price. Elsa's master, per Felt's question.

entities.name: twenty gold coins
entities.description: Exactly twenty blessed gold coins given by Elsa's employer to pay for the badge. Rom returned them to Elsa, deciding the negotiations favored Subaru.

entities.name: Elsa's employer
entities.description:
Summary of the three descriptions:

- Elsa's unnamed employer gave her twenty gold coins for the badge. Their estimates may have been wrong. They do not actually need the badge.
- An unnamed woman hired Felt. Felt says she would report another offer to her, and the woman might counteroffer with more.
- Elsa's unnamed employer gave her this job. Elsa intends to thank them.

entities.name: kukri blade
entities.description:
Elsa holds a weapon that glimmers with a dull light. It is about a foot long, with the blade bent inward near the handle. The heavy tip makes it work like an ax, used to decapitate enemies or prey. It is brutal and clashes with Elsa's overall image.

Elsa holds the blade ready. She struck Subaru with its blunt side, breaking his left shoulder.

entities.name: giant rats
entities.description:
I can't build a full persona sheet from these two notes, since they give almost no information about the character. The only facts available are:

Mentioned by Old Man Rom as animals he threatens to feed Elsa to.
Mentioned in a password-like phrase spoken by Subaru: 'To the giant rats…?' No other details given.
