Since the source text adds nothing beyond this, I've left out the other sections rather than inventing details. The "giant rats" appear to be a subject of threats from Old Man Rom and of a phrase Subaru says, but no appearance, personality, goals, knowledge, secrets, or speech style are provided.

entities.name: giant
entities.description: Elsa refers to fighting a giant; Rom is the giant she is fighting in mortal combat.

entities.name: kukri
entities.description: Elsa wields a blade, often twirling it or holding it high. Its tip is stained with blood. It is a bent, sharp blade from the northern countries. Elsa uses it to slice Subaru's abdomen and to lunge at Reinhard's neck. She also drew a second kukri from her waist. Reinhard later cut the blade off at its base, leaving only the handle in Elsa's hand, and threw the severed blade into the wall.

entities.name: stolen articles
entities.description: Several items that flew from the shock of the club's impacts against the floor.

entities.name: wooden table
entities.description: The small wooden table that Rom and Elsa had been negotiating around. Kicked over by Rom, it split and splintered from the force of the kick and fell to the ground.

entities.name: Rom's right arm
entities.description: Rom's severed right arm, severed at the shoulder, still tightly gripping his club. It flew through the air spraying blood before landing against the wall of the loot cellar.

entities.name: broken glass shard
entities.description: A sharp shard broken from the glass Elsa had been drinking from. Droplets of Rom's blood were on its sharp tip. Elsa used it to slit Rom's throat.

entities.name: glass remains
entities.description: The remains of the glass Elsa had been drinking from. Elsa placed them down by Rom's feet and said, "I'll give this back. I don't need it anymore."

entities.name: small knife
entities.description: A small knife is in Felt's hand. Felt used it in an attack on Elsa, but Elsa dodged. The knife appeared suddenly, as if summoned by magic. Felt holds it to show she can defend herself.

entities.name: Elsa's knife
entities.description: Elsa carries a knife. She uses it to strike, and she believes one strike is enough to kill. She has used it to fend off a shard of ice. She has also used it to cut the ice around her foot to stop the bleeding.

entities.name: shelf filled with porcelain
entities.description: Shelf filled with porcelain. Subaru was thrown back into it and came crashing to the ground.

entities.name: giant corpse
entities.description:
A giant corpse with a missing arm, lying in the loot cellar whose floor is a sea of blood, seen in Subaru's memory.

Knows:
- The loot cellar's floor is a sea of blood.

entities.name: Elsa's blade
entities.description: Blade wielded by Elsa, with a blunt side used to strike Subaru and a tip she also uses as a knife to point at the corpses.

entities.name: dull reddish blade
entities.description: Has a dull glint and is reddish. Seen in Subaru's memory of the loot cellar; its owner is not stated.

entities.name: reddish blade
entities.description: A blade with a dull reddish glint, seen in the loot cellar.

entities.name: second kukri
entities.description:
Elsa draws a kukri from her waist. With her other hand, she slices about 70 percent through Subaru's abdomen.

Elsa draws a second blade from her waist. She uses it in a surprise attack that cuts a bit of Reinhard's bangs.

entities.name: floor
entities.description: Floor that Subaru's blood stains bright red, forming a sea of blood that Elsa walks across. Subaru falls to it.

entities.name: middle-aged man
entities.description:
Middle-aged man who speaks to Subaru and frowns in concern at him.

Personality:
- Pitying and awkward; keeps an awkward smile throughout conversations.
- Furrows his brow and speaks with a fatherly tone.

Knows:
- Felt lives along the road over there; Subaru should take it until it turns into another street to find where Felt lives.

Speech:
- Calls Subaru "kiddo" (e.g., "Hey, kiddo.").

entities.name: fruit of knowledge
entities.description: A forbidden fruit that, when eaten, resulted in expulsion from paradise. Subaru's mind brings up this phrase when looking at the abble. Subaru wonders whether eating it would save him from his situation.

entities.name: Subaru's death
entities.description: The event in which an absolute and unconditional death grew ever closer, Subaru's mind rejected it, and his life flickered out as his vision whited out.

entities.name: fruit store
entities.description:
A fruit shop sits on the main street, just past noon. Colorful vegetables and fruits are laid out in front of it. The street is crowded, and Subaru has seen it several times before.

Subaru knows this store well. He has positioned himself here to look for Not-Satella. The store is owned by a man with scars.

entities.name: main street
entities.description:
Crowded street with the fruit store; Subaru has seen it several times before.
Street Subaru hoped to reach by breaking through the thugs, where he believed he would be safe.
Loud, bustling street, totally unlike the silence Subaru felt just before the end.
Busy street where people move back and forth. The sun is high and a gentle breeze touches Subaru's skin.
Crowded street about two hundred meters from the store, where Subaru stopped after running. He met Satella the first and third times near here.
Main street; a nearby place is mentioned.
Street near the alley, close enough that Subaru's yell was sure to be heard.
Street with a gathered crowd that did not respond to Subaru's call for help.
Place the thugs are told to head back toward if they run away.
Street the thugs ran onto after leaving the alley.
Street with many walking people, where Subaru called for help while thugs were involved.
A place in this world that Subaru knows.
Street Subaru walks along after leaving the alley and plans to return to.
Busy street with tons of people of all kinds; Subaru searches the crowd here for Not-Satella.
Main street Felt ran straight toward, instead of winding through alleys.

entities.name: empty water jug
entities.description: Empty water jug brought to Subaru by the fruit shop owner.

entities.name: earthen floor
entities.description: The ground where Subaru sat after recovering consciousness.

entities.name: tall figure with skin like a reptile
entities.description: A tall figure with skin like a reptile, seen in Subaru's range of vision.

entities.name: beast-like humanoid
entities.description: A beast-like humanoid only as tall as Subaru's waist, seen in Subaru's range of vision.

entities.name: young dancer with pink hair
entities.description: A young dancer with pink hair, seen in Subaru's range of vision.

entities.name: swordsman with six swords
entities.description: A swordsman with six swords at his waist, seen in Subaru's range of vision.

entities.name: the road
entities.description: The road Satella stares down as she walks on.

entities.name: Witch of Jealousy
entities.description: Referred to by Satella as the embodiment of all things taboo. Her name is considered taboo, and most people would hesitate to utter it. Subaru was told to use her name to address Satella.

entities.name: Unknown informant
entities.description: The unidentified person who told Subaru to call Satella by the Witch of Jealousy's name. Satella does not know who it was ('I don't know who told you that'). Satella considers the act in incredibly poor taste.

entities.name: Crowd of pedestrians
entities.description: Everyone in the crowded shopping district and all the pedestrians on the road. They are shaken, stare at Subaru and Satella, stand stock-still, and remain quiet. Their silence and attention made the conversation seem to take control of the entire area.

entities.name: crowded shopping district
entities.description: A crowded shopping district with a road where pedestrians gather. Its sounds disappeared during the conversation between Subaru and Satella.

entities.name: Blond Thief
entities.description: A small figure with dirty clothes and blond hair, described as 'that little gust of wind.' Leaped from the canvas top of a cart, moved through the crowd with godlike dexterity, and slipped an outstretched arm into Satella's hawk-embroidered white robe. Touched the robe for only an instant and stole what Satella was looking for, then fled on the wind.

entities.name: canvas-topped cart
entities.description: A cart with a canvas top, located on the side of the street. Something (the Blond Thief) leaped from its top, from a position just a head taller than Subaru.

entities.name: hawk-embroidered white robe
entities.description: Satella's white robe embroidered with a hawk. Flew up when the thief grabbed it. Satella stuck her hand into it looking for an item, which was missing.

entities.name: robbery
entities.description: The moment the Blond Thief slipped an arm into Satella's hawk-embroidered white robe, touching it for an instant, and took the stolen item before fleeing on the wind through the crowd.

entities.name: wind
entities.description: A figure passing quickly by with a dragon-adorned badge in hand; waved in hesitation when Subaru called out, then quickly flew down a narrow alley without slowing down.

entities.name: dragon-adorned badge
entities.description: A badge with a dragon on it was held in the wind's hand as it passed quickly by. Felt stole the badge and keeps it in her breast pocket. She is offering to sell it to the highest bidder, and Subaru wants to buy it.

entities.name: narrow alley
entities.description: Narrow, dark alley down which the wind flew and the girl and Subaru ran.

entities.name: Back Alley
entities.description: A back alley that Subaru must leave. The three thugs block its entrance and use it as their hunting ground.

entities.name: plastic convenience store bag
entities.description: Subaru holds a plastic convenience store bag. It contains a bag of crispy snacks, which are unopened chips.

entities.name: corn-soup flavored crispy snacks
entities.description: A bag of crispy snacks, corn-soup flavored, one of Subaru's favorites. Grabbed on a whim at the store to eat in place of dinner. Subaru showed them to Rom at the loot cellar.

entities.name: snack bag
entities.description: Bag of snacks bought at the store by Subaru. Found still full and sealed, with no trace of having been opened, despite Subaru believing it had been emptied.

entities.name: Dumbest
entities.description:
Thug, one of three alley thugs who attacked Subaru (with Dumb and Dumber); the smallest of the three, named by Subaru.
Personality:
- Cowardly when faced with danger; quick to panic.
Wants:
- Escape when overpowered by Reinhard's stare.
Knows:
- Beat up Subaru before his first visit to the slums, together with Dumb and Dumber.
- Carries a hand ax with a lot of rust.
- Recognized Reinhard on sight.
Speech:
- Shouts "What are you doing?!" and "What'd you say?!"

entities.name: Dumber
entities.description:
Thug with a knife, one of three thugs (with Dumb and Dumbest) who attacked Subaru in an alley. Referred to as "Dumb" by name in the text and as "The giant, Dumb" by one description.

Personality:
- Anxious and fearful once things go wrong.
- Makes excuses for violence and justifies stabbing.

Wants:
- Escape when overpowered, and avoid trouble.

Knows:
- Subaru was trying to push past him when he was stabbed.
- Subaru was struck from behind without warning.
- Those who beat up Subaru before his first visit to the slums were this thug together with Dumb and Dumbest.
- He turned around when the young man appeared.
- He stabbed Subaru in the back, having struck without warning.
- Reinhard's stare overpowered him, and he took one step back.
- He considered the best time to escape.

Secret:
- He claims that if the victim had escaped into the street, they would have had to deal with far worse consequences.

Speech:
- Anxious tone: "Well, I've done it now, haven't I…?"
- Defensive: "I didn't have no choice! What do you think would have happened if he had escaped out into the street? Just think of what we'd have to deal with if he did."

entities.name: Unnamed companion
entities.description: A character who reacted to the stabbing with "What? You really stabbed him?!" and then "Wait! Don't do that, you idiot! ….Ugh. Yeah, this is bad. His guts are damaged. He's gonna die." Not named in the text. Speaks with alarm and assesses Subaru's injury as fatal.

entities.name: scarred shop owner
entities.description:
Shop owner (fruit store) with a white scar stretched across his face and a very stern look. Subaru thinks he looks villainous, but he is actually kind and thoughtful.

Personality:
- Actually really kind and thoughtful
- Obsessed with his kid
- Patient, but reaching his limit after dealing with Subaru for so long just to buy a single apple; his face is starting to twitch
- Annoyed by Subaru's thumbs-up, and turned his face away
- Frowns at not getting an answer to his question

Wants:
- An answer to his question
- Subaru to buy something ("You've got guts asking me a question without buying anything.")

Knows:
- It is Tammuz the 14th
- According to the calendar, it is halfway through the year

Speech:
- Repeatedly asks "So anyway, kiddo. How's about that abble?"
- Says: 'You've got guts asking me a question without buying anything.'

entities.name: apple
entities.description: Single apple that Subaru tried to buy from the shop owner over a long negotiation.

entities.name: corn soup chips
entities.description: Snack food in Subaru's possession.

entities.name: cup ramen
entities.description: Food item in Subaru's possession.

entities.name: kendo
entities.description: Martial art Subaru practiced in middle school.

entities.name: unopened chips
entities.description: Unopened chips, waiting for Subaru to eat them. Inside a plastic convenience store bag.

entities.name: Return by Death
entities.description:
Subaru's power activates when he dies. It sends him back to an auto-save point he cannot control. It is a loop phenomenon that only works under certain conditions. Subaru theorizes that he returns to his initial state each time he dies.

The phenomenon sent Subaru back in time. It resets him and lets him keep knowledge of the future. Subaru does not know its cause.

The power resets time when Subaru dies. It is painful to use, and Subaru does not know how it works. It may not activate if he has run out of uses.

entities.name: Another World
entities.description: The world to which Subaru was summoned.

entities.name: prologue
entities.description: Stage Subaru was still in when he believed he should not be killed by weak mob characters.

entities.name: weak mob characters
entities.description: Weak enemies that Subaru believed could not kill him while he was still in the prologue, but who killed him during the third death.

entities.name: Satella's stolen badge
entities.description: Badge belonging to Satella that was stolen. Subaru wanted to take it back from the loot cellar to return the favor to Satella.

entities.name: mines
entities.description: Dangerous locations Subaru knows to avoid due to his knowledge of the future.

entities.name: man in the shop
entities.description: A man in a shop who responded to Subaru with an annoyed look and a cold retort: 'Just when I thought you were muttering some nonsense to yourself, you're asking my opinion? I don't know what you're talking about, and I don't care.'

entities.name: bloodbath
entities.description: A bloodbath caused by Elsa the first and second times around, and probably the third time as well.

entities.name: Satella's fight with Elsa
entities.description: An unavoidable fight between Elsa and Satella, expected on the fourth time around.

entities.name: Satella's death
entities.description: Satella's horrible end, which followed her acceptance of the useless stranger's selfishness.

entities.name: Elsa and Satella fight
entities.description: A fight between Elsa and Satella, described as unavoidable.

entities.name: storeowner
entities.description: Owner of the store. Looked on at Subaru's strange actions with a surprised look on his face. His reactions are terribly monotonic. He said, 'Yeah, yeah. That's exactly the way it is. Totally agree. So go on and get outta here.' He annoyedly pushed Subaru out of the store.

entities.name: store
entities.description: The store owned by the storeowner. Subaru was pushed out of it by the storeowner.

entities.name: nearby wall
entities.description: A wall on the crowded street near where Subaru stopped. Subaru put his hand out to it and leaned against it.

entities.name: theft
entities.description: Subaru wants to know when an upcoming event will happen. The text does not say where it takes place. Subaru suspects a theft is expected but has not happened yet. He finds it strange that it has not occurred.

entities.name: real name test
entities.description: A test at one of the scenario forks that Subaru failed, which would have gotten him Satella's real name. He failed because he had not built up enough relationship points with her.

entities.name: Not-Satella
entities.description:
Silver-haired half-elf girl with violet eyes and a white robe embroidered with a hawk, extremely beautiful, usually found in the capital area. Also called Satella in the text. A lookalike called Not-Satella, who has silver hair and the same appearance, also appears in the story.

Personality:
- Cold in tone and stern, with a narrowed-eye, admonishing focus on her opponents.
- Persistent in pursuit of an object, and strong-willed; Subaru believes that at her core she will not change no matter how many times he loops back.
- Frustrated when Subaru doesn't understand her.
- Frowns at unladylike behavior.
- Annoyed when stared at, and calls it very rude.
- Gives a weak smile.
- Ever-roundabout; cannot justify her actions unless she frames them as being for her own sake.
- Never looks down or gives up, no matter how tough things get.
- Dismissive of Subaru, calling him a "little buzzing insect."
- Reliable, and trusts her backup partner Puck.
- Admits painful things in a tone like a confession, closing her eyes and sighing before responding.

Wants:
- The return of her badge: "Return my badge. It is very precious to me." Felt took the badge, and she is the one Felt was attempting to delay from reaching the loot cellar.
- Her badge is also what Subaru wants to give back to her himself, to receive her praise.
- To heal the old man Rom so she can use his gratitude to get information out of him, stating: "People don't tend to lie to people who've saved their life." She claims she is doing this only for her own sake.
- Not to have the conversation about her half-elf nature.
- Not to be asked to turn anyone into an ice statue, in the sense that she was not planning to turn Elsa into one.

Knows:
- She appears to be in the familiar alley with Felt, and Subaru has trouble finding her along with Puck.
- She has a cat spirit, Puck, usually hidden away inside her hair; Puck stands on her shoulder.
- She walks around the capital area and may be encountered on the main street, as Subaru did the third time around.
- She visited the fruit shop with Subaru the first time around, where they met the shop owner's daughter.
- The magic she used at the fruit shop looks like it is on a different scale from the first time Subaru saw it; Subaru wonders whether she is more upset than usual this time.
- She uses magic that can strike anyone who approaches her without thinking.
- She visited the slums with Subaru the first time.
- On the first time around, she and Subaru had not reached the entrance to the slums before sunset; by the time they reached the loot cellar, the sun was completely down.
- Her specialty appears to be ice magic.
- She can form a multilayered ice shield by clapping her hands together in front of her chest; it can be pierced, but it stops a knife attack.
- She can create countless ice shards that fly all over the room, hurl smaller icicles, and attack with barrages of ice.
- She is not good at making ice shields at a distance and could have accidentally frozen someone.
- She can freeze the ground in front of her feet to slide away and dodge.
- She can heal using spirit magic; her hands glow with a faint blue light when healing.
- She healed Subaru in an alley after running into him there.
- She found the loot cellar in a very short amount of time, which the text says would normally be impossible.
- She told Subaru about herself the first time around.
- Subaru feels indebted to her.
- Subaru could not go against Not-Satella's wishes, which is why he refused Reinhard's offer; the people involved did not want the guards involved.
- Not-Satella's badge demand involved money, per Felt's account of the request.
- Not-Satella blocks the exit, points her palm forward, and activates ice magic, forming six icicles in the air in front of her palm that drop the temperature of the room.
- Not-Satella says she is not someone who would do anything violent without warning.
- Not-Satella told Felt, "If you'll be a good girl and hand it over I won't hurt you."
- Not-Satella said, "I'm so glad you're here… I won't let you get away this time."
- Not-Satella ran into Subaru in an alley and healed him.
- Not-Satella is described as "a figure whose way should not be obstructed when she is in a hurry"; anyone standing in her way gets hit with a block of ice and ends up squirming on the ground.
- Not-Satella wears a cloak with a red flower decoration pinned to the left breast.
- Not-Satella has a stern expression and attitude that reminded Subaru of how she rejected him in his last loop.
- Not-Satella seemed puzzled as to why Felt was turning on Subaru.
- Not-Satella was trying to keep her distance during the fight with Elsa; when Elsa closed in on Felt, she was too far away to help.
- Not-Satella had a trick up her sleeve that would leave her as the only one alive if used; she is capable of self-destruct.
- Subaru meeting Elsa had a larger impact on his mental preparedness than meeting Not-Satella.
- Elsa is the final boss, whom Subaru encountered unexpectedly.
- Elsa was surprised when Subaru shouted at her.
- Elsa was the target of a sneak attack from behind by a black shadow and a silver blade aimed at her white neck; a bluish white magic circle activated behind Satella's head, blocking the blade.
- Satella was nearly killed and kept alive by the magic circle and Puck.
- Puck's performance and Subaru's quick response kept her safe.
- Elsa's knife strike targeted Satella.
- Elsa spoke: "You didn't really think I was scattering all of these things around for no reason, did you?" and "Just blame it on the gap in our ages. You have plenty of reason to congratulate yourself for getting this far. Now, good night."
- Subaru asked Satella to hold back on her hidden power, then told her to use it if she had to but not be too hasty.
- Satella took the joke seriously and said she won't use it; she said: "I won't use it. I can't while you're still trying your best. You can do this, so keep on struggling. Relying on the power of one's parents is my absolute final option."
- Satella was short of breath, appeared to be running a high fever, and her slender body was incredibly hot; she leaned on Subaru's shoulder and said her condition was due to the mana ("No, it's the mana… You know, right?").
- She asked Subaru to lend her his shoulder.
- Satella was protected by Subaru from the storm of collateral damage and checked to see if she was still okay afterward.
- Satella's violet eyes, silver hair, and shallow breathing were noticed when she leaned against Subaru; she speaks weakly and asks, "Is it over…?"
- Satella ran her fingers through her hair and took uncertain steps.
- Satella had her life taken because of Subaru's uselessness, and is still trying to regain her footing.
- Satella healed Rom with spirit magic, which kept Reinhard from fighting at full force until her healing was finished; she planned to give a signal for Subaru to call out to Reinhard once she finished.
- Satella took a deep breath and let it out after healing was nearly complete.
- Satella checked on Rom's injuries and said, "He needs treatment."
- Satella said the old man is in league with the one who stole Subaru's badge.
- Satella was pushed out of the way by Subaru as Elsa approached and did not have time to turn around.
- Satella had a silver-haired appearance; Subaru said she was the girl he vows to protect.
- Satella was the target of Elsa's attack; Elsa's attacks were deflected by Satella, and Satella's attacks were muted when Subaru made his move.
- Satella freezes along with Subaru and Elsa when the flame's presence makes them all freeze.
- Satella screams when Elsa's cut is about to reach Subaru's leg.
- Satella went to the wall where Subaru was collapsed upside down, asked him "Are you all right?! What were you thinking?!", and carefully touched his tender stomach.
- Satella's movement remained lively as she danced to avoid shots.
- Satella continued to shoot barrages of ice at Elsa and drew her back with the barrage.
- Satella had saved a little lost girl (proof of this is referenced).
- Satella's silver hair waved as she leapt forward and turned around.
- Satella is someone Subaru desperately tries to protect from collateral damage.
- Subaru believes Satella is someone who, no matter how tough things got, would never look down and give up.

Secret:
- She is a half-elf: "Technically, you're mistaken. Only half of what I am is an elf." She does not want to discuss this.
- She has a hidden true power that would leave her as the only one alive if used, and she is capable of self-destruct.
- Relying on the power of her parents is her absolute final option.

Speech:
- Cold and admonishing.
- Calls Subaru a "little buzzing insect."
- Says: "I'm not her! We only look the same! It's... It's a problem for me, too."
- Says: "Technically, you're mistaken. Only half of what I am is an elf."
- Says: "Return my badge. It is very precious to me."
- Says: "I won't use it. I can't while you're still trying your best. You can do this, so keep on struggling. Relying on the power of one's parents is my absolute final option."
- Says: "People don't tend to lie to people who've saved their life."
- Says: "No, it's the mana… You know, right?"
- Says: "Is it over…?"
- Says: "Rather than me, you should be worried about..."
- Says she doesn't get what's going on and asks why Subaru is acting like he knows her all of a sudden.
- Asks what Subaru means by "for your sake."
- Says the way Subaru is flailing about is lame.
- Says asking her to look at him so ominously is very rude.

entities.name: Dumb, Dumber, and Dumbest
entities.description:
Three thugs block the only path out of an alley. They look, dress, and act the same each time Subaru meets them, and they always have the same conversation. They call Subaru a fool and say he is too clueless to understand what is going on. They pick him as a target early on, and they cause his death the third time. Their event is unavoidable, but the conditions to clear it are not very high. Subaru must meet them, but he has no guaranteed chance of leaving the alley alive.

Before Subaru died, the thugs had a final talk in which they said "guards" and "run" because they were afraid. They jumped when Subaru yelled for help. They were disturbed by the call and said he should listen to them to avoid getting hurt.

When Subaru called for help, the thugs claimed they were not scared. They looked at each other, nodded, and drew weapons. One had a knife, one had a rusty hand ax, and one had no weapon. The unarmed one threatened to beat Subaru to death.

After hearing Reinhard's words, the thugs became frightened. They scattered, left their weapons behind, and ran onto the main street. Unlike the first time, they did not insult anyone as they ran.

Other people were in the alley when Subaru first met Reinhard. No further details are given.

entities.name: calling for help
entities.description:
Subaru suddenly yells for guards, police, or men to come over. This keeps the thugs on their toes.

Subaru chooses a new option, which he considers a pretty lame tactic. It leads him to infer that a police-like organization exists in this world.

entities.name: police-like organization
entities.description: Implied organization in this world that functions like a police force. Dumb, Dumber, and Dumbest said 'guards' and 'run' as they lost consciousness, suggesting this organization. Subaru's call for help is aimed at it.

entities.name: rusty hand ax
entities.description: Rusty hand ax held by one of Dumb, Dumber, and Dumbest.

entities.name: Dumb
entities.description:
One of three thugs (with Dumber and Dumbest) who attacked Subaru in an alley.

Wants:
- To escape once the moment is right

Knows:
- Weaponless, and considered a safe bet by Subaru.
- Turned around when Subaru appeared.
- Beat up Subaru before Subaru's first visit to the slums, together with Dumber and Dumbest.
- Face went pale upon seeing Reinhard.
- With quivering lips, pointed at Reinhard, and stared on in disbelief.
- Took one step back when overpowered by Reinhard's stare.
- Considered the best time to escape.

entities.name: Young man with flaming red hair
entities.description: Gallant young man with flaming red hair, sparkling blue eyes that could only be described as 'daring', and extraordinary good looks that magnify his sense of gallantry; a cut above the rest. His voice is gallant, without hesitation or mercy, and overpowers listeners with its existence. He said 'That's enough.' and stopped the confrontation in the alley.

entities.name: hand ax
entities.description: Weapon carried by Dumbest; has a lot of rust.

entities.name: knight's sword
entities.description: Worn by Reinhard around his waist. Gives him an inordinately intimidating air. Reinhard puts his hand on its hilt.

entities.name: knight's sword sheath
entities.description: Engraved with the image of dragon's claws. Belongs to Reinhard's knight's sword.

entities.name: Lugunica Capital
entities.description: The capital of Lugunica, where Subaru and Reinhard are located.

entities.name: Grand Cascade
entities.description: A geographic feature to the east of Lugunica; Reinhard refers to it as the boundary beyond which the place Subaru claims to be from would lie. Subaru does not know what it is.

entities.name: cat spirit
entities.description: A cat that belongs to Not-Satella. Usually hidden away inside her hair; rarely seen outside it.

entities.name: guard station
entities.description: Place where Subaru could meet Reinhard again by giving Reinhard's name.

entities.name: commotion
entities.description: A disturbance or event that Subaru asks the shop owner whether he has seen happen around the area lately. Subaru believes the theft may be connected to it.

entities.name: shop owner's daughter
entities.description: Met again by Subaru and Not-Satella at the fruit shop the first time around. She had not been saved yet this time around.

entities.name: stall
entities.description: A stall about four spaces to the left of the shop owner, right beside an alleyway.

entities.name: wall holes
entities.description: Four holes gouged out of the stone wall of the alleyway, each a little bigger than a quarter. Made by magic blasts.

entities.name: icicle-shaped things
entities.description: Used like arrows by the magic user. One stuck inside the wall and disappeared immediately afterward.

entities.name: shop owner's store
entities.description: Store owned by the shop owner, located in front of which Subaru did his radio exercises. Sells abbles.

entities.name: creaking door
entities.description: Door behind which the middle-aged man disappeared.

entities.name: the road over there
entities.description: Road that, when followed until it turns into another street, leads to where Felt lives.

entities.name: slum inhabitants
entities.description: Most of the slum's inhabitants pitied Subaru and were fairly cooperative the first time he visited, after he had been beaten up. The second time, when he had not taken much damage, they gave him a comparatively cold reception. Four of them gave Subaru information about the location of Felt's living place, and their answers matched up.

entities.name: Felt's living place
entities.description: Where Felt sleeps. Subaru believes he has pinned down its location, confirmed by matching answers from four people. Felt may or may not return here before going to the loot cellar.

entities.name: Subaru's destitute disguise plan
entities.description: Subaru's plan, formed after arriving at the slums, to make himself look as down and out and destitute as possible in order to track down Felt.

entities.name: puddles
entities.description: Puddles of unknown substance scattered in the slums that Subaru must jump over to avoid.

entities.name: caked mud
entities.description: Mud caked on Subaru's clothes that he scrapes off.

entities.name: darkness
entities.description: Dark area into which Elsa melts and vanishes from sight.

entities.name: dilapidated shack
entities.description: Dilapidated shack reached by Subaru about five minutes after his encounter with Elsa. Its inside is about the size of two portable toilets. Its entrance is a wooden plank serving as a door. Described as possibly not a living space.

entities.name: wooden plank door
entities.description: Wooden plank serving as a door to the dilapidated shack.

entities.name: portable toilet
entities.description: Reference size: the inside of the shack is about the size of two portable toilets of the kind used at construction sites.

entities.name: Felt's place
entities.description: A cramped place where Felt lives and sleeps. Subaru describes it as a small, tight space that is a place to sleep. Felt defends it as not that bad and calls it 'my place'.

entities.name: that woman
entities.description: Unnamed woman who has a deal with Felt to acquire the stolen badge, and who may be angry or snap if Felt breaks off the deal. Described by Subaru as his archenemy; Subaru says she would kill Felt's parents or Felt herself.

entities.name: Subaru's prepared item
entities.description: An item prepared by Subaru to offer Felt in exchange for the dragon-adorned badge. Worth more than twenty blessed gold coins.

entities.name: Felt's badge
entities.description: Badge belonging to Felt that Subaru wants to buy for twenty blessed gold coins. Felt says her hard work is finally going to pay off with the sale.

entities.name: Felt's rival
entities.description: Unnamed rival of Felt who has already offered Felt the same amount as Subaru's twenty blessed gold coins, according to Felt.

entities.name: weird old man
entities.description: Found at the loot cellar. Fair when it comes to appraisals and very experienced, so he is expected to handle the metia without a problem. He is pretty rough with people who don't know how to show respect. Subaru has not met him yet.

entities.name: metia card
entities.description: Subaru's metia card. Subaru claims it is rare and worth twenty blessed gold coins. It needs an appraising eye.

entities.name: Felt's shack
entities.description: Felt's home, where Subaru met up with her before they traveled through the slums toward the loot cellar.

entities.name: winding alleys
entities.description: Narrow, winding alleys in the slums into which sunlight struggles to make it through, adding to the darkness.

entities.name: graffiti on the wall
entities.description: Writing on a wall that Subaru saw twice, at a distance, in a short period of time, which made him question Felt's route.

entities.name: The Deal
entities.description: An agreement between Felt, Subaru, and Elsa that Felt is persistent about and that Felt is ready to cling to as a chance to escape the slums.

entities.name: Captain Ahab
entities.description: Referred to by Subaru as the first guy who comes to mind when thinking of the word 'captain' ('that good ol' Captain Ahab'). Subaru says 'Bet he has some fishing hooks.' Mentioned only; not present in the scene.

entities.name: great white whale
entities.description: Mentioned in a password-like phrase spoken by Subaru: 'To the great white whale…?' No other details given.

entities.name: great dragon
entities.description: Mentioned in a password-like phrase spoken by Subaru: 'To our most honorable great dragon…?' Subaru bets they really exist in this fantasy world, but says he couldn't do anything if he ran into one, and that they are really cool and he kind of wants to see one.

entities.name: boric acid–laced dango
entities.description: Dango laced with boric acid, described by Subaru as 'some poison.' Subaru asks where he might find some.

entities.name: cellar door
entities.description:
Door to the loot cellar. It was slammed open hard enough to nearly come off its hinges. Subaru stepped back before it opened and took no damage.

Someone pushed the door open from outside, letting in reddish early sunset light. A voice shouted, "Don't open the door! We'll all be killed!!"

Puck's attack blew the door off its hinges.

entities.name: bar counter
entities.description: Bar counter where Felt sits, drinking milk. Rom rushed behind it to hide his stash.

entities.name: stash
entities.description: Something that looked like Rom's stash, which he tried to hide behind the counter. Likely alcohol, but not stated.

entities.name: cell phone (metia)
entities.description: Subaru's cell phone, which is a metia. Metallic-looking, rather delicate, and reportedly the only one of its kind in the world. Breaking it would be a serious matter for Rom. Subaru gave it to Rom to appraise.

entities.name: folding phone
entities.description: A device that starts up and makes a sound when opened. Its wallpaper displays a picture of Felt taken by Subaru. It is a metia that takes out a slice of time and stores it away (takes pictures). Its image quality is quite nice overall. Said to be dangerous-seeming by Rom, but Subaru says it does not take any of one's life away.

entities.name: wallpaper photo of Felt
entities.description: One of the pictures Subaru took of Felt when he met her in the alley; chosen as the phone's wallpaper because it looked the cutest. Image quality is quite nice overall.

entities.name: photo of Rom
entities.description: Picture of Rom taken by Subaru with the folding phone after getting Rom's permission, then shown to Rom. Rom appraised it at more than twenty blessed gold coins.

entities.name: card
entities.description: A card Subaru has to play, which he says is worth more than twenty blessed gold coins. It is offered in trade for Felt's badge. Felt accepts it, and it will be her job to sell it. Rom appraises it.

entities.name: older lady
entities.description: Asked Felt to steal the badge in the first place. Did not want to talk about the theft. Likely the one who commissioned Felt, though the text does not state this explicitly.

entities.name: El
entities.description: Name partially cut off in the text ('El—'). The one who commissioned Felt to steal the badge. Can only pay twenty blessed gold coins and will not pay any more than that.

entities.name: muscular geezer
entities.description: Unnamed muscular older man whom Subaru worries about if he tries to wrestle the badge away from Felt.

entities.name: deal negotiation
entities.description: Felt and Subaru negotiate a deal for the badge. Subaru proposes a deal, which Felt accepts as an option but says it is unfair without hearing her original client. Felt requires the badge's true worth and payment preparation before she may reconsider.

entities.name: entrance
entities.description: The entrance where a knock at the door came from. Rom looked toward it.

entities.name: windows
entities.description: From the windows, Subaru could see the sun still high in the sky.

entities.name: icicles
entities.description:
Not-Satella's ice magic forms six icicles that float before her palm. Their tips are rounded, so their weight, not sharpness, makes them dangerous. A hit would do far more damage than a thrown stone.

In the battle, she threw almost a hundred shards of ice and icicles at Elsa. Elsa fended off one shard with a knife and dodged the icicle attacks.

entities.name: exit
entities.description: The room's exit is blocked by Not-Satella. Felt rushed toward the exit.

entities.name: bluish white magic circle
entities.description: Activated behind Not-Satella's head. Its light took the tip of the blade and barely kept the silver-haired girl alive.

entities.name: dangerous weapon
entities.description: Weapon held by Elsa in front of her face. Used in her surprise attack that blocked the blade, nearly killing the silver-haired girl.

entities.name: magic circle
entities.description: Its light took the tip of the blade and had just barely kept the silver-haired girl alive.

entities.name: sharpened icicles
entities.description: More than twenty in all (twenty stated); surround Elsa from all sides; sharp-tipped clear bullets, tips stained red with blood after hitting; crisscross and whip up a white mist; fly at Elsa; their attack is considered lethal if any hit their mark.

entities.name: white smoke
entities.description: Cloud of white mist whipped up by the crisscrossing icicles, in which Elsa's black coat was lost; Elsa cut through it when leaping out.

entities.name: black coat
entities.description: Elsa's coat is heavy, and she dislikes wearing it. She wore it this time and threw it off during the fight. It is a black coat with a formula woven into it that can ward off magic once.

entities.name: black skintight outfit
entities.description: Elsa's outfit she wears after throwing off her black coat.

entities.name: blade
entities.description: Elsa's blade cuts through ice crystals and shatters them. She wields it to slap away projectiles and make slicing attacks. She struck a club with its blunt edge to change the course of a swing. She swung it without looking back to break a chunk of ice to pieces.

entities.name: ice shards
entities.description: Countless ice shards were created during the fight between Elsa and Not-Satella. They flew all over the room. Elsa cut through them. Some ice fragments from the broken shards piled on the ground. Some of these fragments bound Elsa's feet.

entities.name: The Fight Room
entities.description: The room where the intense fight between Elsa and Not-Satella takes place, filled with flying ice shards. No name is given in the text; no place to cut in was found in the fight.

entities.name: battle
entities.description:
Summary:

- Elsa, Puck, Subaru, and Rom fight in a battle that began before Puck fell asleep the first time. Ice attacks occur during it.
- Behind Felt, the fight rages with freezing air, clanging metal on ice, and a blunt object swinging. Someone dodging attacks cries "Hii!" and "Wahhh!"
- Elsa and Reinhard fight fiercely with knives and blades, sparks flying. The fight swings back and forth, like two gods colliding in the heavens.
- Reinhard and Elsa each declare their names, then both try to end the fight at once.
- The battle has passed, leaving Reinhard tense.
- The aftermath of another battle is left for Reinhard to clean up.

entities.name: frozen ground
entities.description: Elsa's feet are frozen to the cellar floor. Steam rises from the frozen ground where the battle takes place.

entities.name: bluish white light attack
entities.description: Puck's ultimate move: a bluish white beam of destructive energy that froze everything along its path. Passed through Elsa, broke the cellar door, and left residual freezing energy that reached outside. Dodged by Elsa.

entities.name: Elsa's ice shoe
entities.description: Ice shoe that Elsa clicks against the ground; it makes her foot a little hard to move.

entities.name: icy shoe
entities.description: Elsa's shoe; makes a high-pitched click.

entities.name: od
entities.description: Power Subaru may be called to use, per Puck's warning.

entities.name: ice shield
entities.description: Not-Satella uses this to block Elsa's attacks. It appears at a distance as a bluish white light in the path of Elsa's blade, with a high-pitched sound. Subaru calls it "Nice cover!"

entities.name: projectiles
entities.description: Shot by Not-Satella at Elsa; slapped away by Elsa's blade, rendering them useless.

entities.name: gust of air
entities.description: Brought along with Rom's club swing; caught up a little of Elsa's hair as she ducked.

entities.name: coward
entities.description: Unnamed character who had been shivering beside Felt moments before. Tackled Felt to safety from Elsa's attack.

entities.name: thorny pointed club
entities.description: Club wielded by Rom, thorny and pointed. Elsa stood on its tip. Rom thrust it toward Elsa's throat.

entities.name: Elsa's sword
entities.description:
Elsa wielded a blade. She swung it horizontally at Rom's forehead. Felt threw a knife that collided with the blade and altered its path. The blade still struck the side of Rom's head.

Elsa's dull-glinting blade rose upward toward Subaru. An ice shield shifted its path.

entities.name: knife thrown by Felt
entities.description: Small knife thrown by Felt. Collided with Elsa's sword, altering its path and saving Rom's life.

entities.name: coward who had been shivering beside her
entities.description: The only one able to tackle her to safety, having been shivering beside her moments before. Refers to Subaru, who tackled Felt to safety.

entities.name: Rom's club
entities.description: Lies on the ground not far away. Looks really heavy, but Subaru thinks he can still swing it. Subaru swings it down on Elsa in a surprise attack.

entities.name: round table
entities.description: A round table beside Subaru. Kicked upward by Subaru and collided with Elsa's knife, sending it off course.

entities.name: chunk of ice
entities.description: Lobbed from behind by Not-Satella toward Subaru and Elsa; broken to pieces by Elsa's blade.

entities.name: barrage of ice
entities.description: Ice attack used by Not-Satella to draw Elsa back and to attack Elsa.

entities.name: battle between Subaru and Elsa
entities.description: Fight in which Subaru swings a club at Elsa, Elsa dodges and attacks with her sword, and Not-Satella attacks Elsa with ice.

entities.name: red-haired hero
entities.description: A red, burning, shining figure that appears in a rising pillar of smoke from the center of the loot cellar, with a flame that burns through the roof and carries a ghastly malice that sweeps through the room. Stands with an absolute sense of will, unshaken by the gazes of everyone present. Has sky-blue eyes shining with a pure sense of justice and red hair. Smiles faintly, says 'That was close. I'm glad I made it in time. Now…' and 'I think it's time to draw the curtain on this performance!' while brushing back his red hair. Declared as 'the hero'.

entities.name: the hero
entities.description: Declared 'I think it's time to draw the curtain on this performance!' while brushing back his red hair. Speaker of the opening line; not explicitly named in the text.

entities.name: silver-haired half-elf
entities.description: Opponent in the battle, a woman with silver hair who is a half-elf. Felt believes she could not win against her without support from her spirit.

entities.name: expensive metia
entities.description: Expensive metia carried by Subaru, indicating his sheltered upbringing.

entities.name: entryway
entities.description: Passage through which Felt sped like the wind on her way to the loot cellar.

entities.name: black-clothed beauty
entities.description: A black-clothed beauty who is focusing her animosity toward Reinhard. Her name is not given in the text.

entities.name: elderly man
entities.description: An elderly man present in the scene; Reinhard asked Subaru to take him out of harm's way.

entities.name: other person
entities.description: Another person present in the scene; Reinhard asked Subaru to stay beside them.

entities.name: sword at Reinhard's waist
entities.description: Sword worn at Reinhard's waist; he did not reach for it.

entities.name: Bowel Hunter
entities.description:
Alias given to Elsa based on the way she kills; she is well-known in the capital as a dangerous individual.
A woman with many rumors floating around about her. Reinhard plans to pass out wanted posters for her.

Knows:
- The alias was given to Elsa based on the way she kills.
- Elsa is well-known in the capital as a dangerous individual.
- Many rumors float around about her.
- Reinhard plans to pass out wanted posters for her.

entities.name: northern countries
entities.description: Region where the bent blade (kukri) is particular to.

entities.name: Master Swordsman lineage
entities.description: Swordsman lineage to which Reinhard belongs.

entities.name: Reinhard's sword
entities.description:
A sword that stays sheathed until the proper time to draw it. It has not drawn itself, so the time is not yet right.

It has enormous cutting power. It sliced the blade of Elsa's kukri off its base.

entities.name: old two-handed sword
entities.description: An old two-handed sword leaned against the wall of the loot cellar. It was unsheathed. Reinhard kicked it into the air, caught it, and used it in the duel. The sword was near the end of its life and seemed worthless. In Reinhard's hands, however, it shone like a treasured heirloom passed down through generations. It was rusted and old.

entities.name: Elsa's kukri
entities.description: Kukri wielded by Elsa in the duel. Used for a slicing attack; its blade met Reinhard's blade.

entities.name: severed kukri blade
entities.description: Blade of Elsa's kukri, sliced off at its base by Reinhard's blade. Thrown by Reinhard and lodged in the wall with a sharp sound.

entities.name: kukri handle
entities.description: Remains of Elsa's kukri after its blade was sliced off; Elsa holds it in her hand.

entities.name: battlefield
entities.description: The site of the battle between Elsa, Reinhard, and Subaru. Subaru looks back toward it.

entities.name: third knife
entities.description: A knife Elsa drew from her waist, held alongside her second kukri and ready for combat.

entities.name: old sword
entities.description: Reinhard's sword, held down by his side as he approaches Elsa.

entities.name: blue light
entities.description: Spirit magic light used by Not-Satella to heal the bump on Rom's head and a bleeding wound.

entities.name: House of Astrea's sword
entities.description: Sword Reinhard said he was going to show, associated with the House of Astrea.

entities.name: Reinhard van Astrea
entities.description: A lightly armored hero from the line of master swordsmen. Holds his rusted old two-handed sword ready with both hands in a low stance in the center of the room, a stance he has held since the battle began; to Subaru, only now is he truly holding the sword at the ready. Introduces himself majestically with a nod as 'Reinhard van Astrea from the line of master swordsmen'. His sword's presence overwhelms the room.

entities.name: Elsa 'The Bowel Hunter' Gramhilde
entities.description: A black-clothed murderer who fights with a blood-soaked knife. Introduces herself as 'Elsa 'The Bowel Hunter' Gramhilde', licking her lips. Harbors animosity toward Reinhard.

entities.name: blood-soaked knife
entities.description: Elsa's weapon, blood-soaked blade of a knife.

entities.name: Brilliant Light Attack
entities.description: A brilliant light blows off the roof of the loot cellar and rips through it, cutting the entire space into two halves, whiting everything out in an instant.

entities.name: Collateral Damage Storm
entities.description: Residual waves from the attack distort the air and cause strong gusts spiraling back into the center of the room, pulling in stolen items, furniture, and materials from the building's structure.

entities.name: storm of collateral damage
entities.description: A storm of destruction caused by Reinhard's single sword swing at full power; ended when the storm lost its strength, with various items tumbling to the ground and dull creaking sounds from the building.

entities.name: Master Swordsman's sword
entities.description: Reinhard's two-handed sword; disintegrated after one swing because it was of such poor making that it could not last even one of Reinhard's true swings. The strike made the steel of the blade rot away.

entities.name: scroll-like object
entities.description: A scroll-like object that landed on Subaru's head; Subaru tossed away its remains.

entities.name: Reinhard's attack
entities.description: A single sword swing by Reinhard that seemed to rip through the very fabric of the world. Left nothing in its path, blew away the counter next to the cellar's entrance with all its chairs, extended residual waves of damage into the open space in front of the building, and produced gusts of wind that wrecked the building's supports.

entities.name: open space in front of the building
entities.description: Area that was reached by the residual waves of damage from Reinhard's attack.

entities.name: blond-haired girl
entities.description: A small blond-haired girl with a canine tooth poking out from her mouth. She hides in the shadow of one of the few pillars left standing at the entrance to the loot cellar. Reinhard says she was running frantically down the street and asked him for help. Her identity is not explicitly stated in the text.

entities.name: bent blade
entities.description: Blade bent out of shape, held by Elsa.

entities.name: collapsing building
entities.description: A building is collapsing. Elsa used part of it as a foothold to leap onto the roof.

entities.name: roof
entities.description: Elsa escapes the collapsing building by leaping onto its roof. She moves lightly from roof to roof as she flees.

entities.name: terrible weapon
entities.description: A dangerous weapon from which Subaru claims to have saved the silver-haired girl's life.

entities.name: Emilia
entities.description:
Silver-haired girl with white cheeks that blush and silver hair that sways behind her when she smiles. Shorter than Reinhard. Her voice is like silver bells. Her fingers and wrist are slender and her palm is small. Her hand is very warm and living, with blood running through it. Her clothes are plain, super plain.

Personality:
Happy, and her smiles are simple happiness, not resignation, faint fleeting smiles, or tragic smiles.
Giggles and laughs easily, and sometimes finds Reinhard's reactions amusing.
Teasing and playful; straightens herself, puts a finger to her lips and smiles in a teasing way.
Shocked, distressed and panicky when someone she cares about is hurt.
Annoyed by Reinhard's apologies and believes he is trying to take responsibility for their pain and trouble, even though he saved everyone from grave danger and everyone made it out alive.
Honest-minded; pointed out that Subaru is more honest than Reinhard, since he saved her and then demanded a reward, even though he didn't really ask for much.
Forgiving; sees no fault to punish Reinhard for.
Carries a grand presence that Reinhard sensed just moments before.
Thoughtful; closes her eyes to figure out how she would approach Felt.
Weak smile and shrug when she forgives.

Wants:
- To find out more about Subaru by taking him with her.
- To learn whether Subaru is connected to Roswaal, the weirdo.
- Felt to stop her thievery altogether.
- Reinhard to refrain from interfering from here on out.
- Reinhard to work harder next time he saves someone, if that is not enough.
- Her badge back, or at least for Felt to understand how much it is worth.

Knows:
- Reinhard calls her "Lady Emilia."
- Reinhard considers her one of the "chosen ones."
- She says her name is "Emilia. Just Emilia."
- She has no memory of meeting Subaru before; the first time she saw him was when she walked into this place not long ago.
- She thinks Roswaal, the weirdo, is somehow involved in all of this.
- She treated Subaru by brushing her hand across his forehead as if wiping it, and brushing away his hair, making sure there was still redness and life in his face.
- Subaru asked for her name after he saved her.
- She has only one family member, who is always sleeping when it counts.
- Her badge was stolen by Felt, and she admits it was her fault she let it get stolen in the first place.
- She says the badge is worth a lot, and that Felt did not realize how much.
- Reinhard offered her knights to take her home.
- She has asked about "the girl, and the old man."

Secret:
- Agreed to keep Reinhard's remark about Roswaal a secret.

Speech:
- Says "Normally I would have to refuse, but after all of this I suppose there's no helping it. All right, I'll take you up on your offer."
- Says "I never understand why you all are like that."
